name: Aladdin - Naam Toh Suna Hoga
description: Aladdin is an age-old fantasy tale of a 20-year-old boy and his travails around his family and love. It is an absolute family entertainer show. It has got the fantastical factor of classic tale as well as the nail-biting thriller, heart-warming romance and affecting family equations. Despite being set in a very old legendary talismanic era, all the characters are entertaining, yet relatable which makes the fans correlate with its humor.

videos.title: The Righteous Thief
videos.overview: Aladdin, a lovable rogue, hopeless romantic poet and a righteous thief who likes to help the urchins, is in love with the Princess Of Baghdad, Yasmine. But little does Aladdin know that his life is going to turn upside down when his escapade will lead him to a magical lamp which possesses a magical Genie who has been trapped inside it for 500 years.

videos.title: The Blue Diamond
videos.overview: Zafar Khan is the Wazir-e-Azam of Baghdad, who wishes to get his hands on the magic lamp and marry Princess Yasmine to become the Emperor of Baghdad, but Princess Yasmine wants to become the first Empress of Baghdad herself. Aladdin receives his next mission to steal Zimmidar Habibullah's, Blue Diamond.

videos.title: And That's How They Met
videos.overview: The Black Thief, Aladdin, is assigned to steal the famous Blue Diamond so the owner of the diamond, Zimmidar Habibullah comes to Princess Yasmine and asks her for protection. Princess Yasmine herself goes to the place where the diamond is kept and Aladdin reaches there to steal the diamond. What will happen now?

videos.title: The Search for the Magic Lamp
videos.overview: Aladdin is assigned to find the magic lamp by Wazir-e-Azam Zafar Khan, who gives him a map. The map leads Aladdin to Maghreb Desert, where he struggles to find the lamp. On his way, he comes across Princess Yasmine in Salim Khilji's den. What will happen now?

videos.title: Destination Khatrapur
videos.overview: Aladdin, in search of the magic lamp, meets Princess Yasmine on the way again. Yasmine was looking for him as she thought that he had stolen her bag which contained the book. They both are then approached and invited by the people of Khatrapur to the small village, where a big trouble is waiting for them.

videos.title: The Mystical Land of Two Moons
videos.overview: As the sandstorm settles down, Khatrapur disappears into oblivion. The people saved by Aladdin show their gratitude. Then, the land of the two moons beckons Aladdin. Rising from the sand are guards, who can't be killed by Aladdin. To go past the guards made of sand, Aladdin has to slay them. Will Aladdin figure a way out?

videos.title: The Final Obstacle
videos.overview: After Aladdin faces the ultimate protector of the magic lamp and saves him from dying, the protector himself escorts Aladdin to the cave where the magic lamp is kept safe but also warns him as it's the last and the most dangerous obstacle. Will Aladdin be able to to get the magic lamp safely?

videos.title: Trapped
videos.overview: Aladdin overcomes the final obstacle and finally comes across the magic lamp and a great treasure but as he takes the magic lamp one coin from the treasure also gets in his pockets somehow. So he gets trapped inside the cave.

videos.title: Meet The Jinn
videos.overview: The Jinn comes out of the lamp and is scared to see Aladdin. The Jinn is unaware of its identity until Aladdin makes it realize. Meanwhile, Umer is waiting outside the cave for Aladdin. When Umer has lost all hope and presumes that Aladdin is dead, Aladdin comes out of the cave with the Jinn.

videos.title: Getting Back
videos.overview: Umer makes Aladdin realize that the Genie is his responsibility now and if the magic lamp and the Genie go into the wrong hands, there'll be chaos everywhere. So Aladdin and Genie start their journey back to Baghdad but on their way back Aladdin loses the navigation device.

videos.title: Genies New Family
videos.overview: Although Umer informed Aladdin strictly that the Genie and the magic lamp is his responsibility now, Aladdin gets frustrated and decides to ditch the Genie and head back to Baghdad on his own. But somehow Genie follows him back to Baghdad and comes in front of everyone.

videos.title: The Chaos
videos.overview: Aladdin is the center of attraction at the supper party organized by his mother. Nazneen is suspicious of Aladdin's new friend and wants to find out more about him. Meanwhile, Genie is making himself comfortable in his new surroundings.

videos.title: Your Wish Is My Command
videos.overview: Nazneen is curious to find out the secret of Aladdin's sudden rise to fame. Her appearance before Genie triggers a panic attack for Genie and he creates a storm. After the storm settles down, the people humiliate Aladdin and his mother.

videos.title: Tamatar Ka Safar
videos.overview: Aladdin and Rukhsar are surrounded and harassed by all the loan sharks. Zafar plans to control everyone in Baghdad by starving them.

videos.title: Zafar's Fury
videos.overview: Princess Yasmine goes out on her conquest to find and capture the bald guy and somehow reaches the mastermind behind everything through him. Aladdin convinces Genie to go back inside the magic lamp and takes it to Zafar for the exchange, not having any clue about Zafar's plan to take the lamp and capture the Black Thief.

videos.title: Escapades
videos.overview: Zafar is furious when he finds out that the Black Thief has escaped. Aladdin and Yasmine are captured by the bald man and are handcuffed to each other. Zafar gets the news of the Black Thief being captured by the bald man, so he decides to go there himself. While Yasmine waits in captivity to confront the Moustache Mastermind, Aladdin plans to escape.

videos.title: The Secret Saviour
videos.overview: Aladdin yet again escapes from the Bald Man's confinement with Princess Yasmine. The Bald Man then calls out his crows and sends them to pursue Aladdin and lead them into his trap. Aladdin and Yasmine get trapped in the Bald Man's trap.

videos.title: The Magic Carpet
videos.overview: Aladdin and Princess Yasmine are trapped inside a cage and Zafar is on his way to get the magic lamp from the black thief, so Aladdin somehow sets fire around the cage preventing Zafar from entering the area. Just when Aladdin's mother is about to get arrested for not paying the money lenders, a secret savior gives her some money and saves the day.

videos.title: A Father's Cry
videos.overview: The Jinn with a twist of his wrists turns an ordinary carpet into a magic carpet, with the help of which Aladdin escapes with Yasmine before Zafar can catch him and get hold of the magic lamp. The Jinn escorts Aladdin and Yasmine to their home. Meanwhile, Zafar has turned diabolical due to his failure to possess the magic lamp.

videos.title: The Truth Serum
videos.overview: Aladdin and Princess Yasmine return to Baghdad with Genie's help. Aladdin's mother tells him about his father and how they lost everything in that fire. Gulbadan slips a truth serum in a drink and passes it to Aladdin to get the truth out of him.

videos.title: Search For The Magic Lamp
videos.overview: Genie drinks the juice in which the truth serum was added by Gulbadan so he is compelled to tell Aladdin's mother the truth about him being 400 years old. At the same time, Gulbadan with his mother comes to get the truth out of Genie. Zafar has a new plan in his mind to get the magic lamp back.

videos.title: Secrets Of The Past
videos.overview: Aladdin bumps into Piddi while in search of Genie. Piddi, who is head over heels in love with Aladdin, forgets the question and starts daydreaming. Then, Aladdin finds Genie and learns that Genie has given the magic lamp to strangers. Now, Aladdin has to get the magic lamp before it falls on Zafar's lap.

videos.title: Introspection
videos.overview: Aladdin manages to get the magic lamp from the hands of Zafar's subordinates. Meanwhile, Nazneen is cajoling Genie into revealing his true identity. Aladdin's father visits his old house which is burned down. At the same time, Aladdin and his mother also arrive.

videos.title: Aladdin's Introspection
videos.overview: Aladdin and his mother enter their old house and miss Aladdin's father by just a few seconds. Aladdin does some introspection and decides that he is going to give up the magic lamp to the mustache guy. Princess Yasmine saves her father from getting killed by a falling chandelier.

videos.title: The Exchange
videos.overview: Aladdin signals Muchadd and makes sure that he knows where the exchange of magic lamp is going to take place. Muchadd understands the signal and reaches the Chaand Mehel disguised as an old man. Little does Aladdin know that Zafar plans to either arrest or kill him after the exchange.

videos.title: Zafar's Plan
videos.overview: Aladdin is asked to remove his mask and in return, Muchhad will reveal his identity. Meanwhile, Yasmine finds out that one of the guards is a snitch. The guard is captured and interrogated but he doesn't reveal any details. Muchhad has decided to end Aladdin's life on the night of Jashn-e-Fateh. Will Aladdin find out about the plan?

videos.title: Destined
videos.overview: Zafar plans to kill Badshah Alam on Jashn-e-Fateh and hires a killer who is none other than Aladdin's father. Aladdin's mother goes to the market accompanied by Genie to celebrate Jashn-e-Fateh. Aladdin is worried about her mother so he goes out to find her and bring her back.

videos.title: A Tough Decision
videos.overview: Aladdin makes a hard decision of letting Genie go and giving him to Muchhad and when he informs the same to Genie, he is devastated. The news of Genie leaving and never coming back saddens Aladdin's mother to the core. Omar prepares for the assassination of Princess Yasmine's father.

videos.title: The Assassin
videos.overview: Zafar dreams of sitting on the throne, but standing in his way is the current Sultan of Baghdad. Meanwhile, Omar has arrived in the city to assassinate Sultan Shahnawaz. When the Sultan is greeting the people, Yasmine grows suspicious.

videos.title: A Father And A Son
videos.overview: Aladdin is still in a dilemma whether he should hand over the magic lamp to Muchhad or not. Omar is in his position and marks Badshah Alam with his arrow to assassinate him. Will Aladdin give the Genie to Zafar or will he change his mind?

videos.title: Genie Is Back
videos.overview: Aladdin fools Zafar by giving him a fake magic lamp but later realizes that the coins that Muchhad gave him were also fake so he brings Genie back home and apologizes to him. Princess Yasmine tells Badshah Alam everything about Muchhad and his planning.

videos.title: The Doppelganger
videos.overview: Zafar comes across a man who resembles the Sultan. An evil plan is conceived by Zafar to exploit this find to his advantage. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Yasmine are at a feast. Genie's magic turns Aladdin and Yasmine into dancers, while Genie tries to defuse the tension between the two.

videos.title: A Confession
videos.overview: Aladdin confesses his love for Princess Yasmine but when Yasmine reveals her identity he doesn't believe her. Zafar's men try to pursue Omar again, into an attempt to kill Badshah Alam. Yasmine almost catches Sultan Shahnawaz's doppelganger.

videos.title: Wicked Conspiracy
videos.overview: Zafar sends Omar in Badshah Alam's room to assassinate him and then replace him with his doppelganger. But just when Omar is in Badshah Alam's room to kill him, Princess Yasmine arrives at the same time.

videos.title: Sultan's Announcement
videos.overview: Yasmine is eagerly awaiting her coronation as the Sultan. She hopes that her father will make the announcement shortly. But, the Sultan announces that Yasmine is getting married. Meanwhile, Nazneen sends Gulbadan to Aladdin's house, and asks him to hide the bangles at his place. Will Aladdin find out about Nazneen's plan?

videos.title: The Suitor
videos.overview: Zafar reveals to Yasmine that she will be getting married to Zayn, who has a rather special ability. Meanwhile, Nazneen blames Aladdin for having stolen the golden bangles. Ruksar is certain that Aladdin hasn't stolen the items and asks Nazneen to search her house.

videos.title: Zayn's Hocus
videos.overview: Zafar and Zayn plan to hocus princess Yasmine's mind by using Zayn's abilities, and control her in any way they desire. Nazneen asks Aladdin to swear on his mother that he has never stolen anything from anyone. What will Aladdin do now? Will he be able to convince his mother?

videos.title: Under The Influence
videos.overview: Zayn hypnotizes Princess Yasmine and asks her to complete a task, in order to get a hold of her mind completely. Aladdin realizes that Yasmine is in danger so he decides to rescue her. Rukhsar and Omar almost come face to face.

videos.title: Genie Is Compromised
videos.overview: Zayn sends Princess Yasmine to fetch the black rose in order to complete the process of controlling her mind. Aladdin tries to stop her from doing that but Genie, who is under the influence of Zayn's magic, attacks him.

videos.title: Saving The Princess
videos.overview: Princess Yasmine is under Zayn's hocus, and Zayn tries to diminish all the memories of her family and loved ones, in order to compel her mind and her heart. Aladdin gets to know about this plan, so he decides to protect Yasmine. Will Aladdin be able to save Yasmine, while fighting against Genie, who is under Zayn's spell?

videos.title: Aladdin Is Adamant
videos.overview: Yasmine is still under Zayn's hocus and Aladdin is adamant about saving the Princess, so he tries to get Genie out of Zayn's influence, so that he can help him save Yasmine. Zayn completes the process and controls Yasmine's mind and heart.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: Aladdin defeats Zyan and breaks the magic pendant, this gets Yasmine out of his influence. Aladdin decides to bring Yasmine to his home, in order to protect her, while she is unconscious. Zafar almost kills Zayn after hearing the news of Princess Yasmine escaping.

videos.title: Calling Out Aliza
videos.overview: Aladdin brings the unconscious Princess Yasmine to his house, in order to protect her from Zayn. Zafar forces Zayn to call out Aliza and take her help, in order for him to get to his goal. Nazneen Begum sees Yasmine at her shop and starts asking questions.

videos.title: Wicked Game
videos.overview: Princess Yasmine gets to know about Nazneen using her wicked plans to damage Aladdin and his mother's relations, so she decides to teach her a lesson. Zayn calls out Aliza and she shows up and turns Zayn into a poisonous moth and orders Zayn to kill Aladdin.

videos.title: The Deadly Scorpion
videos.overview: Aliza turns Zayn into a deadly scorpion and asks him to kill Aladdin. Aladdin, Genie, and Ruksar decide to go to the mosque and Zayn comes there, and plans an attack on Aladdin. Princess Yasmine feels that something is off with her father, so she decides to confront him.

videos.title: Another Failed Attack
videos.overview: Zayn keeps on trying to attack Aladdin and bite him after turning into a poisonous scorpion, but fails every time. Aladdin asks his mother why do people call his father a traitor. Nazneen successfully ruins the food made by Aladdin's mother for the poor people.

videos.title: To Catch A Sight
videos.overview: Genie gets to know that Nazneen has put some kind of drug in the food prepared by Aladdin's mother, which can make everyone sick, so he decides to use his magic to prevent this from happening. While at the mosque, Aladdin gets to know that Princess Yasmine is there to visit the mosque, so he runs outside to catch a glimpse of her, where Zayn is waiting for him.

videos.title: Aliza Shows Herself
videos.overview: While Aladdin is trying to catch a glimpse of Princess Yasmine, his mother gets stung by the poisonous scorpion, Zayn. Aladdin picks his mother up and rushes to the doctor. Zafar gets frustrated and calls out Aliza and finally, she shows herself.

videos.title: The Venom Does The Work
videos.overview: The venom that Zayn injects in Aladdin's mother's neck, seems to be working as she starts walking unconsciously and even forgetting her memories. Aladdin gets a job offer from Mahal, and decides to take it up to get closer to Princess Yasmine.

videos.title: Perseverance Is The Key
videos.overview: Aladdin is adamant about joining the job at the Mahal, to get close to Princess Yasmine, but his mother is concerned about his safety. Genie decides to train Aladdin for the job. Omar decides to let the real Badshah go.

videos.title: Free To Go
videos.overview: Omar lets the real Badshah go, and he ends up going to the place where Princess Yasmine and the fake Badshah are doing charity amongst the poor. Aladdin brings his mother home, after saving her from the guards, but feels that something is wrong with her, after noticing her weird behavior.

videos.title: Aladdin
videos.overview: Yasmine's father tries to break the security in an attempt to speak with his daughter, but Omar stops him in his tracks. Nazneen breaks into Aladdin's house and steals the magic armor. The next day, Aladdin enrolls his name for the competition. Aladdin hopes to turn his fortune around by landing with a job. Unaware to Aladdin, Gulbadan has something that Aladdin doesn't.

videos.title: Struggle Is Real
videos.overview: Aladdin finds out about Nazneen stealing his magic armor and giving it to Gulbadan, who is also participating in the competition. Yasmine is worried about her father, so she decides to discuss the situation with Piddi.

videos.title: Finding The Truth
videos.overview: Aladdin's mother motivates him from the ringside, while he is getting beaten by the other competitor. Zafar and Aliza come close to find the Black Theif's protector. Yasmine and Piddi's plan works, as they are able to reveal the fake Badshah.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Aladdin and Genie bring Aladdin's mother home, but when she wakes up from the temporary coma, she refuses to recognize them. Princess Yasmine confronts the fake Badhshah, but just then someone attacks him.

videos.title: Three Days and Counting
videos.overview: Genie reveals to Aladdin that Rukhsar has been poisoned. Rukhsar has to be saved within three days, but there isn't a known antidote available to cure her. Meanwhile, Zafar pushes the fake Badhshah off the balcony and becomes a hero in the eyes of Yasmine. Will Yasmine find out Zafar's true identity? And will Aladdin be able to save his mother?

videos.title: Breaking the Enchantment
videos.overview: Genie reveals to Aladdin that the one who has mastered the art of magic, will be able to cure Rukhsar. But, Mallika, who had truly mastered the dark arts, has turned to stone. The only way to save Rukhsar is to search for a solution, which is buried in one of the books, containing all the secrets of magic. Genie asks Aladdin to take care of Rukhsar, while he goes in search of the solution.

videos.title: The Red Book
videos.overview: Genie decides to find the Red Book, which contains the solution to break the enchantment on Aladdin's mother. After acquiring the Red Book, Genie realizes that to break the enchantment, they have to travel to the mountains of Mehran. Yasmine, who is looking for some answers, also decides to go with Aladdin to the mountains of Mehran.

videos.title: Mehran, The Valley Of Death
videos.overview: When Genie informs Aladdin and Yasmine that they will find the solution to their problems in Mehran, without even thinking for a split second, both of them decide to leave for Mehran. But, little do they know that a huge obstacle is waiting for them in Mehran, which is also called the valley of death.

videos.title: Aliza's Plan
videos.overview: Zafar and Aliza realize that the Black Theif and Yasmin are traveling to Mehran to find a solution, to save Aladdin's mother, so she decides to hinder their journey by raising a storm. Due to the storm, they crash land into the city of death, Mehran, where Aliza waits for them.

videos.title: The Mirror World
videos.overview: Aliza's plan works as she successfully traps Aladdin and Yasmine in a mirror world, in an alternate universe, where there's death at every door. Aliza then informs Zafar that her next step is to trap the Genie in the magic lamp and get it to him.

videos.title: Trapped
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine are trapped in the mirror world and they try every possible way to escape from there. Genie is trapped by Aliza's magic and gets pulled into the magic lamp. Aladdin and Yasmine find two mirrors where they can't see their own reflections, so they decide to jump into one of those mirrors.

videos.title: An Attempt To Escape
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine somehow escape the mirror world and meet Ilmi Baba and ask him for answers to their problems, but Ilmi Baba challenges them for a combat, in order to prove their worth. Aliza and Zafar are successful in capturing Genie.

videos.title: The Answers
videos.overview: Ilmi Baba finally agrees to answer a question posed by either Aladdin or Yasmine. Aladdin tricks the sage into answering not just one question but two. Illmi Baba reveals the secrets to save Aladdin's mother and Yasmine's father. Finally, Ilmi Baba opens a portal for Yasmine, through which she can escape the magical land. But, what about Aladdin? How will Aladdin find a way out?

videos.title: The Showdown
videos.overview: Ilmi Baba sends Aladdin to the place where Aliza has taken the magic lamp with the Genie inside it, so when Aladdin reaches there and witnesses Aliza in possession of the magic lamp, he has no other option but to get it back and protect it.

videos.title: Genie's Rage
videos.overview: Seeing Aladdin in trouble, Genie becomes enraged. Genie's anger knows no bounds and he grows in size and power. Zafar is ecstatic seeing that Genie is finally out of the magic lamp and decides to exploit the situation. Meanwhile, Yasmine manages to find her father, but Omar isn't far away.

videos.title: Good Triumphs Over Evil
videos.overview: Thanks to Genie, Aladdin comes out alive of the magical maze created by Aliza. Zafar fails to make Genie his slave and returns to Baghdad, to find that the Emperor Shahnawaz has returned. Meanwhile, time is running out for Aladdin, as he needs to save his dying mother. Will Aladdin succeed in saving his mother?

videos.title: Forced To Leave
videos.overview: A mob comes to Aladdin's house and asks them to leave the house and the area, as they believe that Aladdin's family carries a dark spirit with them. Zafar is furious after knowing that Badshah Shahnawaz has returned, so he starts torturing people.

videos.title: The Meeting
videos.overview: In the darkness of the night, Omar meets Mucchad. The two plan to usurp the Emperor. Meanwhile, Nazneen is plotting to evict Rukhsar. Aladdin decides to find a solution, in an attempt to stay in the house. Aladdin plans to use the power of the good to defeat the forces of evil. Will Aladdin succeed?

videos.title: Joining Forces
videos.overview: Zafar manipulates Omar and they both join hands and decide to destroy Badshah Shahnawaz. Aladdin decides to take Badshah Shahnawaz's help and meet him, in order to clear the stain on his father's name. Omar decides to find the Black Theif, so that he can through with his plans.

videos.title: A Father's Dream
videos.overview: Aladdin tries to enter the royal palace and talk to Badhshah Shahnawaz about his father and to clear his name once and for all. Princess Yasmine decides to fulfill her father's long-lost dream. Zafar puts a bounty on the Black Theif's head.

videos.title: The Sultana
videos.overview: The Emperor announces that Yasmine will be crowned as the Sultana of Baghdad. Yasmine's happiness knows no bounds, as her dreams have finally come true, but Zafar is infuriated. The Emperor also announces that the work on the oil wells will be overseen by Yasmine. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Genie learn that workers are required for the newly announced oil well project. Aladdin and Genie decide to take up the job, but fate has other plans for them.

videos.title: The Crown Thief
videos.overview: In this episode, Aladdin carries out the task given by Nazneen and tries to steal the crown. Omar is on a quest to catch the Kala Chor, and tries to figure out the modus operandi used by the thief. When Aladdin tries to steal the crown, Omar attempts to catch him.

videos.title: A New Beginning
videos.overview: Omar tries to catch Aladdin, but the clever thief escapes. Meanwhile, Aladdin meets Yasmine while trying to escape Omar. Yasmine and Aladdin acknowledge their diverging paths in life, and decide to focus on their respective responsibilities. While Aladdin decides to focus on his new job, Yasmine decides to take the responsibilities of a Sultana seriously.

videos.title: Zafar's Ploy
videos.overview: Aladdin and Genie are ready to take up their new job, but Nazneen blackmails Aladdin and asks him to steal the royal crown. Zafar plans to assassinate Sultana Yasmine, at the oil digging site, when she arrives there. Will Aladdin and Yasmine's path cross once again? Will he be able to dodge the new problem coming their way?

videos.title: The Landslide
videos.overview: Huge stones come rolling down at the people on the oil digging site, but Aladdin's quick thinking saves the day and Zafar's plan fails again. But people start leaving the site, thinking that the landslide might be a sign from God. So, Princess Yasmine faces the trouble of convincing the people not to leave.

videos.title: Gaining People's Trust
videos.overview: As people start walking off the oil digging site, Princess Yasmine enters the scene, to convince people otherwise. Omar crosses paths with Aladdin's mother during his search for the Black Theif. Aladdin helps Yasmine to convince the people at the oil site to come back and work.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Aladdin and Genie decide to meet Yasmine, after they learn that she is looking after the work going on at the oil well. However, Gulbadan stops Aladdin and Genie from meeting Yasmine. Later, Rukhsar arrives at the oil well, to meet Aladdin and Genie. Then, Nazneen reminds Aladdin of the task he has to carry out. Meanwhile, Omar has set up a trap to catch the infamous Kala Chor.

videos.title: The Clash
videos.overview: Aladdin falls in the trap set up by Omar and then the two clash with each other. While Omar wants to catch the Kala Chor, Aladdin wants to escape. The two are ready to fight till death, in order to get what they want. Will Aladdin be able to escape or will Omar catch him?

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: Aladdin escapes before Omar is able to catch him. Omar learns that the Kala Chor works at the oil well, and decides to work there to accomplish his mission of nabbing the wanted thief. Meanwhile, Yasmine reinstates Zafar, which could turn out to be a costly mistake. Will Omar learn that Aladdin is the Kala Chor?

videos.title: Omars Escapade
videos.overview: Omar enters the mine in search of the Kala Chor, after getting to know that it was Kala Chor who saved Badhshah Shahnawaz from his captivity. Omar doubts Aladdin to be the Kala Chor after he finds the same wounds on his hand as the Kala Chor had, after he fought him. Will Omar reveal Aladdin to be the Kala Chor?

videos.title: A Mothers Concern
videos.overview: Zafar is furious due to his plans failing one after the other, so he starts torturing people around him. Later, he comes up with a plan to spread terror and fear among the people of Baghdad. Aladdin's mother is concerned for him and Genie after a bad dream, so she decides to tag along with them to the mine.

videos.title: Placing The Bombs
videos.overview: Zafar, disguised as a street artist, reaches the oil mine with his partners in crime, in order to plant bombs there. Aladdin suspects one of the street artists and follows him. Will Zafar be able to execute his deadly plan successfully?

videos.title: The Distraction
videos.overview: Zafar sends his man to plant the bombs inside the mine. Zafar creates a distraction by organizing a dance celebration. While all the workers are outside, enjoying the dance, Zafar's man manages to plant the bombs. Will Aladdin and Genie be able to avert this disaster?

videos.title: The Discovery of Oil
videos.overview: While trying to capture Mucchad's men, Aladdin discovers oil. Aladdin is hailed as a hero, and a celebration follows this landmark discovery. But, amidst the celebrations, Aladdin is concerned about the bombs placed in the mines. How will Aladdin avert the disaster that is about to happen?

videos.title: Chaos Everywhere
videos.overview: Aladdin and Genie try to defuse all the bombs in the mines, amidst the celebration of finding the oil. They are successful in defusing some of them but not all. So, when the bombs start exploding, people try to run out from the mines to save themselves. What will Aladdin and Genie do now?

videos.title: The Savior
videos.overview: Yasmine witnesses the destruction in the oil mines and prays to the lord to send a savior and Aladdin emerges as that savior and saves as many people as he can. He takes his mother and Omar and takes them to the relief camp. But, in the process of saving other people, Genie gets injured badly.

videos.title: A Pray To The Gods
videos.overview: After witnessing the destruction and fire at the mining site, Rukhsar urges everyone in the camp to pray to the Gods to send a solution. Aladdin saves Princess Yasmine from the fire, and Genie uses his magic to pour rain over the fire and rescues everyone.

videos.title: The Unfinished Task
videos.overview: Genie, Aladdin and Yasmine return to Baghdad safely. While Aladdin is delighted to be back home, Rukhsar doesn't waste a moment to remind him of his unfinished task. However, Aladdin refuses to carry out the task at any cost. Meanwhile, the Emperor announces that jobs will be provided at the palace to those credited with the discovery of oil. Will Aladdin stand a chance of landing the job?

videos.title: Finding The Truth
videos.overview: Aladdin is about to start his job in the palace, so he promises his mother to find the truth behind his father's death. Omar is happy to know that his wife is still alive. Princess Yasmine is still devastated to find out about Aladdin's feelings, so she decides to keep Aladdin away from her and gives him a job in Kabul.

videos.title: Aladdins Job
videos.overview: Aladdin's job is hanging in the balance as his name is not announced until the end. Elsewhere, Rukhsar is confronted by Nazneen and her husband, and an argument breaks out against Omar being a traitor, where Rukhsar takes a very strong vow in front of the whole market.

videos.title: The Vow
videos.overview: Seeing Rukhsar in tears, Omar vows to return only when he proves his innocence. Meanwhile, Nusrat, who is in charge of the royal kitchen, sets things right following a fiasco created by Genie and Gulbadan. Will Omar be able to prove his innocence?

videos.title: The Moment Aladdin Awaits
videos.overview: On one hand, Omar is looking for a way to prove his innocence by attacking Emperor Shahnawaz, and Aladdin is excited to serve the emperor, as that shall answer his innumerable questions about his father, but unfortunately, Nusrat chains Aladdin so that he can't meet the emperor. Will Aladdin be able to speak to the Emperor?

videos.title: Omars Revenge
videos.overview: While Omar is looking forward to expose Emperor Shahnawaz, Aladdin disobeys Nusrat and gets expelled from his job. Will the circumstances change for Aladdin and Omar?

videos.title: The Locked Door
videos.overview: Nusrat learns that Aladdin is Omar's son. Aladdin is searching for Mir Mustafa and finds a locked door, which has Mustafa's name engraved on it. However, Nusrat doesn't want Aladdin to unlock the door. Meanwhile, Yasmine decides to meet Aladdin. What secrets does the locked door contain?

videos.title: In the Search of Mir
videos.overview: Aladdin fools Yasmine into washing the utensils. Meanwhile, he searches the room of Omar's best friend, Mir. While doing so, he gets caught red-handed by Nusrat, who decides to help Aladdin in search of Mir. Will the search of the room yield any result?

videos.title: The Secret of Mir
videos.overview: Nusrat and Aladdin find a book in Mir's room which has Farsi writing. Yasmine helps Nusrat and Aladdin to decode what's written in the book. Zafar visits Mir and tries to extract the secret which Mir has kept for 20 years, and fails to do so. Zafar also reveals to Mir that his old and best friend Omar is alive. Aladdin visits the market to find out more about Mir. Will he achieve something?

videos.title: Trip to Spice Market
videos.overview: While Zafar tries to look for clues as to what Mir is hiding from him, Aladdin who is looking for Mir in the market is spotted by Zafar. He then chases Aladdin to enquire as to why is he looking for Mir. Will he be able to catch him? Watch to find out.

videos.title: The Man Who Disappeared
videos.overview: Aladdin gets a helping hand from Yasmine in his quest to find Mir Mustafa. While trying to trace Mir's location, Aladdin and Yasmine fall into a pit. In the dark unexplored chamber, Aladdin finds an amulet and a jar. Will these items help Aladdin find Mir Mustafa?

videos.title: Time is running out
videos.overview: Every moment when Aladdin feels he has hit jackpot, he gets stuck at another dead end, but Rukhsar motivates him saying that no effort goes in vain and he should keep on trying. Will Aladdin be able to save Mir?

videos.title: The Incomplete Love Story
videos.overview: Jinoo and Aladdin go to Nusrat's room to find out the truth about the amulet which has her name engraved on it. Nusrat finally tells Aladdin and Jinoo her story of love with Mir and how he left her in the middle of no where. Aladdin promises that he will find Mir. Will he be able to deliver on his promise?

videos.title: Saving Mir Mustafa
videos.overview: Zafar stabs Mir Mustafa and Aladdin finds Mir in a bad state. Aladdin takes Mir Mustafa back to his house and tries to save his life. Meanwhile, Nusrat meets Ruksar and informs her that Aladdin is trying to find Mir Mustafa. What secrets will Mir Mustafa reveal?

videos.title: The End of Mir
videos.overview: Even though Aladdin saves Mir from Zafar's attack, Mir's situation is critical. Nusrat has mixed emotions about seeing Mir. Mir also clarifies that Omar is innocent. After Mir dies, Aladdin finds a key in his hand which belongs to Aladdin's old house. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Mysterious Key
videos.overview: The key which Aladdin found in the hand of dying Mir is taken under custody by Rukhsaar and she asks Aladdin to not to go to their old house. Aladdin steals the key and goes to the house. What will he find there?

videos.title: The Magical Ink
videos.overview: Aladdin goes to his old house and with the help of the key which he got from Mir, he opens a secret door in the house which leads to another trap door in the house. What will Aladdin find in the end?

videos.title: The Magical Book
videos.overview: After Aladdin enters the secretive cage in his old house, he finds an ancient magical book. The book tells him about all the genies made by the magical queen Mallika. Aladdin on hearing this, is very excited as Jinoo is not the only genie alive. What shall happen next?

videos.title: The Ring
videos.overview: Behold the magical ring that shall end the life of the one foolish enough to steal it. Aladdin receives the warning and dares to risk his own life to find hidden secrets. Mucchad is closely watching Aladdin and wants to steal the book, which Aladdin wants to safegraurd. Meanwhile, Genie and Yasmine accidentally bump into Nazneen. Is Yasmine and Genie’s cover blown?

videos.title: Aladdin's Retreat
videos.overview: After having a fierce battle with Zafar for the magical book, Aladdin loses the book to Zafar. Genie and Yasmine come and rescue him from there. Zafar opens the book and its asks for a price for all the questions asked. Will Zafar pay the price.

videos.title: Genie Of The Ring
videos.overview: Aladdin and Zafar come to know about the Genie of the Ring and Malika, the creator of the Genies. Both realize that Aladdin is very important to acquire the Ring. Omar sees Ruksar but doesn't let her know it's him.

videos.title: The Secret Message
videos.overview: Zafar sends a message to Aladdin in a coded form. Before Aladdin can open the envelope and decipher the message, Nazneen snatches the envelope from Aladdin's hand and asks him to make a trip to Egypt on an assignment. When Aladdin refuses, Nazneen reminds him that he is yet to prove that his father is innocent. Will Aladdin make the trip or will he decipher Zafar's message?

videos.title: Jinoo's Fun
videos.overview: Aladdin is trying to battle Zafar in order to stop him from trying to get the magical ring. Jinoo has fun with Gulbadan, when Gulbadan enters into the competition of representing Baghdad in Egypt, Jinoo uses magic and fails Gulbadan.

videos.title: Unravelling the Secrets
videos.overview: Aladdin is on the lookout for Mucchad, who has managed to escape from Aladdin's hands. Aladdin meets Yasmine and she convinces Aladdin to join hands with her in an attempt to find Mucchad. Before escaping, Mucchad reveals to Aladdin that he is embarking on a trip to Egypt.

videos.title: Expedition to Egypt Begins
videos.overview: Aladdin is set to sail for Egypt with other Yasmine to find Mucchad and expose him to the world. Before they leave, Aladdin meets Zafar and introduce each other. Also, Aladdin is trying to locate Mucchad in the market with the help of a compass which has Mucchad's braclete in it. Will Aladdin find him?

videos.title: Jinoo's Duty
videos.overview: Two days into the expedition to Egypt, Aladdin has still not figured about the identity of Muchhad. On the other hand, Jinoo is on house duty of protecting Rukhsaar but himself is in trouble. What will happen next?

videos.title: Entry into Egypt
videos.overview: As the expedition has reached on the entry gates of Egypt, the mystical gates ask Zafar to solve a riddle and only then can they enter into Egypt. On giving the wrong answer, they will all lose their lives. Will Zafar answer correctly?

videos.title: Zafars Plan
videos.overview: Zafar announces that the doors to Egypt will open at dawn. The next morning, the doors are opened and Zafar is sure that the Genie of the ring will be under his control. Zafar wants to head to east, while the rest of the caravan is marching west. Aladdin and Yasmine are on a mission to catch Mucchad, and stop him from getting to the Genie of the ring.

videos.title: The Unseen Future
videos.overview: In this episode, Aladdin and Yasmine are determined to find Mucchad. Meanwhile, Omar wants to teach a lesson to Nazneen so that she doesn't trouble Rukhsar in the future. Nazneen asks Rukhsar to leave the house and Gulbadan finds the magic lamp.

videos.title: Genies Fate
videos.overview: The caravan reaches Egypt. Aladdin suspects that Mucchad's accomplices are traveling with him. Then, Aladdin gets the sign that Mucchad is nearby. Along with Yasmine, Aladdin decides to find Mucchad. Then, a fire breaks out at the camp, which creates panic. Meanwhile, Omar stops Gulbadan from stealing the magic lamp.

videos.title: Zafar A Step Closer
videos.overview: After the tents catch fire, there's panic everywhere and Zafar takes advantage of the situation and becomes Mucchad. He reaches to the pyramid where Genie's ring is. Aladdin on seeing this, shouts to stop everyone, but it's of no use. Can Aladdin stop Zafar?

videos.title: Mucchads Trap
videos.overview: Mucchad has laid down a very well planned trap for all the members present in the expedition to Egypt. He takes them inside the pyramid where he plans to sacrifice their lives to Zehral, in order to gain access to the Genie's ring. Can Aladdin save them?

videos.title: Rise of the Creature
videos.overview: Aladdin has to rescue the innocent people and also catch Mucchad, who has possession to the key. Then, out of nowhere rises a creature no one has heard of before. The creature has the power to burn anyone to death. As the creature approaches, Yasmine puts her life on the line in order to save innocent lives.

videos.title: Rukhsaar Comes To Rescue
videos.overview: Aladdin and Mucchad are in a fix where Muchhad is ready to trade the key for the bridge if Aladdin retrieves the ring in which the genie is there. Elsewhere, Omar's setup has worked properly in defaming Aladdin's uncle and family, when Rukhsar comes to their rescue. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Ring or The Key?
videos.overview: Aladdin asks Mucchad to stop the creature from devouring the innocent people. Mucchad asks Aladdin to fetch him the Genie of the ring and in return, he will help him save the lives of the people. Aladdin decides to get Mucchad the ring, but will Mucchad keep his end of the deal?

videos.title: Mucchad Gets The Ring
videos.overview: After Aladdin gives the ring to Mucchad and gets the key from him, Aladdin decides to save the innocent lives first, and then take care of Mucchad later. Elsewhere, Yasmine plans to take on Zehral single handedly. Will Aladdin be able to save the innocent lives and Yasmine be able to kill Zehral?

videos.title: Behold The Genie Of The Ring
videos.overview: The people safely get out of the pyramid in the nick of time. Mucchad wants to send Yasmine away so that he can release the Genie of the ring. Aladdin realizes that Mucchad has deceived him and has taken the real ring. Then, Mucchad makes an attempt to release the Genie from the ring. Will Mucchad succeed in his evil plan?

videos.title: Genie Of The Ring Unleashed
videos.overview: The Genie of the ring is unleashed and the Genie tells Zafar that he is fortunate that he is the owner of the ring. Zafar is annoyed by the Genie of the ring as he challenges Zafar's competency. What will be Zafar's reaction?

videos.title: Show Off Genie
videos.overview: The Genie of the ring shows-off his powers in front of Zafar by controlling Akbar's mind. Zafar is blown away by it. On the other hand, Jinoo and Aladdin meet Rukhsar after a long time. The Genie of the ring is still annoying Zafar by asking him puzzles. What will Zafar do about it?

videos.title: Brothers Love
videos.overview: While Jinoo is sleeping, Aladdin confesses about how much he loves him and how much Jinoo has given them since he entered their lives. Elsewhere, Yasmine's friend Princess Meher slams down a helper for laughing. Aladdin and Jinoo find the Genie of the ring in their house. What will they do now?

videos.title: The Evil Genie
videos.overview: Going against Aladdin's warning, Genie steps out of the house. Jinn-e-Anghuti has sensed the presence of Genie and decides to track him. Aladdin sees a magical object in the sky and fears that Genie might be in trouble. Then, Aladdin rushes to Genie's help. Is Genie safe?

videos.title: Saving Gulbadan
videos.overview: As everyone is trying to save Gulbadan from the kite, Jinoo blames himself for the condition of Gulbadan. Aladdin consoles Jinoo that it's not his mistake. Aladdin also suggests that if you can't hide from the enemy it's better to come out and attack the Jinn-e-Anghuti and capture him first before Jinn-e-Anghuti captures Jinoo.

videos.title: Aladdin Wishes To Meet Yasmine
videos.overview: As Aladdin wants to meet Yasmine, she goes to him and gives him a task of eating a whole chilly, if he completes the task, Aladdin gets to meet the princess. Elsewhere, the paste of chilly prepared by Aladdin and Jinoo cures Gulbadan of his problem. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Jinn-e-Anghuti is on Jinoo's trail. Meanwhile, Aladdin is trying to escape from Omar. Jinoo decides to hurry and reach home before Aladdin does, but Jinoo falls unconscious and is found by Aladdin. Jinn-e-Anghuti is catching up and determined to catch Jinoo. After Jinoo regains consciousness, Aladdin asks him to find a way out before Jinn-e-Anghuti catches up. Will Aladdin and Jinoo escape?

videos.title: Jinoos Apology
videos.overview: Aladdin motivates Jinoo to do something so that they can escape from Jinn-e-Anguthi. Jinoo creates a tornado and they both escape from there and dupe Jinn-e-Anguthi. Post they have escaped, Jinoo apologizes to Aladdin for not following orders. Aladdin consoles Jinoo and assures him that he won't let anything happen to him. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Talismanic Chain
videos.overview: After Princess Meher orders Aladdin's ears to be cut-off, Yasmine rescues her. While the guards were taking Aladdin, he notices his amulet is missing and worries for Jinoo and rushes home to find him safe. Elsewhere, Jinn-e-Anguthi has a new weapon to catch Jinoo which is the talismanic chain.

videos.title: Chain Captures Aladdin
videos.overview: As the talismanic chain is out to capture Jinoo, it encounters Aladdin on the way. Aladdin figures that there's something wrong and in turn, the chain captures Aladdin and takes him away. Will Aladdin be able to escpae the chain and get free?

videos.title: Buried
videos.overview: Aladdin encourages Jinoo to use his magical skills so that they can overpower Jinn-e-Anghuti. Aladdin and Jinoo enter a cave and bury Jinn-e-Anghuti, unaware that Mustafa is watching them. Meanwhile, Zafar is waiting for the arrival of Jinn-e-Anghuti, believing that Jinn-e-Anghuti will bring Jinoo along with him. Now that Mustafa has seen the cave, what will he do now?

videos.title: The Ominous Entity
videos.overview: Jinn-e-Anghuti latches onto Mustafa and makes him do things as per his will. Jinoo decides to stay in the house as per Aladdin's wish but Jinoo gets curious when he hears kids playing outside. Meanwhile, Zafar is awaiting the arrival of Jinn-e-Anghuti, unaware that the Genie is in Rukhsar's house to find the identity of the men who buried him.

videos.title: Mustafa Out Of Control
videos.overview: After Mustafa has been taken under the control of Jinn-e-Anguthi, he is out of control and shouting at everyone. Rukhsar decides to help Mustafa. Jinn-e-Anguthi thinks that Rukhsar sounds sensible and will be the right person to know the details about Aladdin and Jinoo. What information will the Jinn-e-Anguthi get?

videos.title: Possessed
videos.overview: Jinn-e-Anguthi possesses Mustafa. Gulbadan comes across Mustafa and gets scared after seeing him enraged. Aladdin learns from Gulbadan that another Jinn is probably in the house. Aladdin and Jinoo decide to go to the cave to find out if Jinn-e-Anguthi has escaped.

videos.title: Face to Face With Genie
videos.overview: After entering the cave, Aladdin finds a bracelet which belongs to Mustafa. On seeing Mustafa in the cave, he understands that Mustafa is under the control of Jinn-e-Anguthi. The Jinn-e-Anguthi questions Aladdin regarding Jinoo. What will happen next?

videos.title: Zafars Threat
videos.overview: After the Jinn-e-Anguthi goes back without Jinoo, Zafar is not happy with his result and mocks him. Jinn-e-Anguthi lies to him about not being able to find Jinoo. He asks Zafar to trust him, but Zafar tells him that he's only got one last chance, otherwise he will put him back in the ring and throw the ring away. What will happen now?

videos.title: The Troubling Situation
videos.overview: The guards arrest Aladdin and take him to the palace. Yasmine sees Aladdin being taken to the palace and follows him. Aladdin is brought before Meher, who asks Aladdin to take her on a tour of the city. When Aladdin is freed, he goes in search of Jinoo. Will Aladdin be able to find Jinoo?

videos.title: Motivating Jinoo
videos.overview: Aladdin tells Omar about the Jinn-e-Anguthi and Omar is optimistic about defeating the Jinn-e-Anguthi as they know the most powerful Genie in the world and that is Jinoo. Aladdin and Omar try to convince Jinoo that he can fight the Jinn-e-Anguthi and defeat him. What will be Jinoo's reaction?

videos.title: Panic In Baghdad
videos.overview: Aladdin reaches home to find his mother and Jinoo safe. Jinoo and Aladdin go to the city market and they see the people in the market talking about what's happening in Baghdad. What Jinn-e-Anguthi did a few moments back has induced fear and panic among the people of Baghdad. How will Aladdin fight the situation?

videos.title: Jinn-e-Anguthis Plans
videos.overview: Aladdin spots Yasmine in the cave where Omar and Jinoo are trying to train. He stops her right there and strikes a conversation and somehow manages to send her away. On the other side, Zafar is angry with the Jinn-e-Anguthi as he has not been able to do anything as of yet to catch Jinoo.

videos.title: The Strength Within
videos.overview: The people of Baghdad are in fear after Jinn-e-Anguthi issues a threat. Omar and Aladdin try to help Jinoo realize his inner strength and use his magical skills against Jinn-e-Anguthi. Meanwhile, Yasmine learns that a Jinn has terrorized the people of Baghdad. What will Yasmine and Aladdin do against the powerful Jinn-e-Anguthi?

videos.title: Saving Baghdad
videos.overview: Jinn-e-Anguthi possesses Gulbadan. In the middle of the night, Nazneen and Rukhsar find Gulbadan trying to set a fire in the neighbourhood. Meanwhile, Yasmine is getting jealous of Meher as she is starting to like Aladdin. Jinn-e-Anguthi sends out a warning to Jinoo and vows to unleash wrath in the city. How will Jinoo and Aladdin save Bagdhad?

videos.title: Practice Makes Perfect
videos.overview: Yasmine gets stirred by Meher and Aladdin's closeness. Jinoo is in practice, trying to get his powers under control. While the whole of Baghdad is afraid of the dark Jinn-e-Anguthi, the only way for Jinoo is to fight back and save the common people.

videos.title: The Magical Battle
videos.overview: Jinoo is determined to fight Jinn-e-Anguthi in order to safeguard Aladdin and Rukhsar. Jinn-e-Anguthi and Jinoo engage in a fierce battle, but Jinoo is defeated. Jinoo vows to try harder next time and defeat Jinn-e-Anguthi. Meanwhile, Nazneen gathers her neighbours to find Jinn-e-Anguthi and teach him a lesson. Aladdin takes Meher on a trip around Baghdad.

videos.title: Ominous Presence
videos.overview: Aladdin takes Meher on a trip of Baghdad on the magical carpet. Jinn-e-Anguthi creates a spell that causes trouble for Aladdin. Then, Jinoo informs Aladdin that he and Jinn-e-Anguthi engaged in a fight. Rukhsar's neighbours request Rukhsar to help them get rid of Jinn-e-Anguthi's ominous presence.

videos.title: Possessed
videos.overview: Rukhsar informs her neighbours that with the use of a mirror they can spot the Genie. Aladdin and Jinoo are worried as Rukhsar can find out Jinoo's true identity with the help of that mirror. Then, Nazneen gets possessed by Jinn-e-Anguthi. Rukhsar finds Aladdin unconscious and gets worried. What has happened to Aladdin?

videos.title: Mirrors
videos.overview: Jinn-e-Anguthi plays a trick with Rukhsar and makes her believe that Aladdin is unconscious. On the other hand, Jinoo is nervous seeing mirrors everywhere and fears Rukhsar will find out his true identity. Aladdin instills confidence in Jinoo and takes him outside the city to meet Omar. How will Aladdin and Jinoo defeat Jinn-e-Anguthi?

videos.title: Realizing His Powers
videos.overview: Aladdin goes to meet Bulbul who tells him that he needs atleast a thousand thorns from a specific venomous plant which will help him in the battle against Jinn-e-Anguthi. Elsewhere, Jinoo is getting trained by Omar, who unleashes a bee hive of Jinoo.

videos.title: The Unforgiving Desert
videos.overview: Yasmine receives a letter from which she learns Aladdin and Meher's travel escapade. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Meher are travelling through the desert. In Baghdad, Jinoo is scared of getting caught and tries to hide from every mirror possible. Jinn-e-Anguthi unleashes another attack and tries to destroy every mirror. Will Jinoo and Aladdin defeat Jinn-e-Anguthi?

videos.title: The Training
videos.overview: Aladdin and Meher arrive at their destination. Aladdin is attacked by predatory cacti and it is Yasmine who saves Aladdin from the attack. Meanwhile, Nazneen gathers the neighbours and creates a ruckus outside Ruksars house for not catching the Jinn. Jinoo blames himself and seeks help from Omar to enhance his magical skills.

videos.title: Music Of Pain
videos.overview: Aladdin and Meher return to Baghdad. Jinoo and Aladdin decide to meet Aladdin's Ustad, who has devised a new musical instrument that has the power to render the Jinn weak. Rukhsar decides to use this musical instrument to capture Jinn-e-Anghuti. But, the musical instrument also affects Jinoo. Will Jinoo succumb to the pain? Will Aladdin be able to capture Jinn-e-Anghuti?

videos.title: Princess Yasmine To The Rescue
videos.overview: Meher sends a notification to Aladdin indicating that she is in trouble. When Aladdin comes to see her, Meher tells him that it was all a joke and Aladdin gets mad at her. Princess Yasmine sees both of them, and locks them in their room and goes alone to save Baghdad.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Rukhsar comes face-to-face with Jinoo's real identity. Rukhsar refuses to call Jinoo as her son and Jinoo breaks down in tears. Nazneen arrives with the neighbours and asks Rukhsar to open the door. Meanwhile, Meher orders to take Aladdin captive. What will happen to Jinoo?

videos.title: Jin Turns To A Jin
videos.overview: Jinoo is heartbroken as his so called mother send him out of the house after knowing the truth about his reality. Aladdin comes back home and is made to feel guilty about not being there when it mattered for his mother or Jinoo. His mother knows that Aladdin has also lied about Jinoo's reality.

videos.title: Jinoo Turns Against Aladdin
videos.overview: Jinoo's elder Jin brother tries to manipulate him when Jinoo uses his powers and pushes him away. Meanwhile, Rukhsar regrets sending him away from her and asks Aladdin to call him back. When Jinoo comes back, he behaves strangely.

videos.title: Chasing The Chiraag
videos.overview: An evil Genie runs away with Aladdin's lamp. Yasmine and Aladdin chase him and try to get hold of the lamp. They use a lot of trickery to stop the Genie. But will they be able to get hold of him?

videos.title: Zafar's Demand
videos.overview: After capturing Jinoo, Zafar becomes the new master of the lamp. He asks Jinoo to decorate his court and after that asks him to take him to the Baghdad's treasury. Once they are there, he asks Jinoo to kill his first master. What will Jinoo do?

videos.title: Zafar Controls Jinoo
videos.overview: Zafar takes control of Jinoo and as his master orders him to kill Aladdin. Aladdin reminds Jinoo of all the good old days and reminds him of his mother as well. Will Jinoo let Zafar control him?

videos.title: Aladdin Repents
videos.overview: After Jinoo has almost killed Aladdin, Zafar calls Jinoo back into the magical lamp. Aladdin is repenting on the fact that he should have been there to protect him. Yasmine persists on knowing the fact about Jinoo.

videos.title: Jinoo's Memory
videos.overview: Now that Zafar controls Jinoo and his affection for Aladdin and Rukhsar comes in the way of Zafar's intents, he orders Jinoo to erase all his memories of Aladdin and Rukhsar. How will be a changed Jinoo be?

videos.title: Yasmine Orders Meher
videos.overview: Yasmine asks Meher to leave the palace as she is not able to serve her responsibilities. Meher denies and urges that she wants to stay back. But Yasmine is adamant and makes sure that Meher leaves the palace. Later, Aladdin dreams of Jinoo and cannot sleep the whole night.

videos.title: Yasmine's Father Is Back
videos.overview: Nakchadi is very happy as her father returns. Meanwhile, Abbu and his family got kidnapped, but Abbu is unaware of the reason why he and his family got kidnapped.

videos.title: Genie In A Negative Role
videos.overview: With a new Akka aka Master, Genie undergoes a transformation. He becomes a negative being, and humiliates, condemns and harms Anghuta Chap. On the other end, Aladdin is trying to find ways to have Genie back.

videos.title: Aladdin And Yasmine On A Mission
videos.overview: Rukhsar prays for Jinoo's well-being and wishes that he returns soon. Yasmine and Aladdin look for a house where Jinoo has been held captive and being tortured. Yasmine is grateful as Aladdin returns her bracelet.

videos.title: Zafar's Dream
videos.overview: Both Aladdin and Yasmine are lost in their own thoughts of how they feel when they are with each other. On the other hand, Zafar wants to rule Baghdad and to know his status he goes to the market in disguise for his validation.

videos.title: Jinoo Refuses To Recognize Aladdin
videos.overview: Jinoo laughs it off when he realizes that the Kala Chor is a girl. Aladdin tries his best to find where Jinoo is. Aladdin can't believe himself when he realizes that he has been developing a soft corner for Yasmine. When Aladdin finally comes across Jinoo, he refuses to recognize him and shows hatred towards him.

videos.title: Jinoo After Aladdin
videos.overview: After Jinoo has failed to recognize Aladdin and has kept him captive, Aladdin uses his intelligence to get free from captivity and runs away. Jinoo starts looking for Aladdin and warns him that as soon as he finds him, he will kill Aladdin.

videos.title: Aladdin Talks About Jinoo
videos.overview: Aladdin is so excited seeing Yasmine that he hugs her tightly. Yasmine is shocked when Aladdin tells her that Jinoo tried killing him. Aladdin still believes that Jinoo somewhere remembers him and Rukhsar.

videos.title: Jinoo Attacks Zafar
videos.overview: Seeing Zafar dressed like Kala Chor, Jinoo starts attacking him. Rukhsar pulls Aladdin's ears when he misbehaves with their guests. Aladdin informs Yasmine that the sundial will help them lead to Jinoo's lamp.

videos.title: Aladdin The Saviour
videos.overview: Wazir gifts a sword called Shamsher to Princess Yasmine. They are having a conversation just when two men attack them. Aladdin comes to their rescue and single handedly defeats those two men. Wazir summons Gullu and his family at his court to know what information they have collected till now.

videos.title: Aladdin Decides To Propose Yasmine
videos.overview: Rukhsar guides Aladdin to propose Yasmine before its late and in the meantime, he gets a reminder of finding Jinoo. Yasmine informs him about the depleting magical Dhoopghadi when he meets her. Later, Aladdin tries finding a way to make Dhoopghadi work so as to find Jinoo.

videos.title: Yasmine Tricks Zafar To Hide Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin hides in Yasmine's room while Zafar arrives and tries entering, but Yasmine somehow stops him. Later, after Zafar's exit, Aladdin plans of searching the three rooms of the castle to reach Jinoo and the magic lamp.

videos.title: Zafar To Impress Yasmine

videos.title: Yasmine Questions Zafar
videos.overview: Zafar talks to himself after getting drunk. Ali comes looking for Jinoo's lamp and fails. Yasmine calls for Zafar and needs to ask him questions. Yasmine is starting to have doubts about Zafar's integrity. She interrogates him with trapping questions.

videos.title: Nazneen Gets The Truth Goggles
videos.overview: Anguthi tries to save Bulbul Chacha when the truth goggles fall off his bag. Nazneen takes it and escapes. Will the truth come before everyone? Zafar tells Ali about the conversation with Yasmine.

videos.title: Aladdin Coaxes Out The Truth
videos.overview: Aladdin purposely gets himself trapped in a net and instigates Zafar to tell the truth. Zafar comes clean and Anguthis ring records everything. They also manage to get Jinoos lamp and escapes with Aladdin and the ring.

videos.title: Aladdin's Plan To Expose Zafar
videos.overview: Aladdin threatens Zafar and escapes with the ring, Jinoo's lamp, and returns to the palace. He has a little problem with the blue color on his body but that is managed. The truth giggles breaks and Ali is about to release Jinoo.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: The lamp with Ali is the duplicate lamp and they cannot release Jinoo yet. Ali and his friends propagate the news that the truth will be revealed soon. Chachi comes up with a new evil trick.

videos.title: Aladdins Ghost Haunts Zafar
videos.overview: Zafar is well known about the intentions of Aladdins ghost and to escape the same, orders all the people to not show up outside the respective house after evening. On the other side, Aladdin as Ali plans for his success and to meet Yasmine before the confession.

videos.title: Execution Of The Plan
videos.overview: According to the plan, Aladdin gets ready to go in front of the people of Baghdad and confess his truth. But one of his self-made team members arrives with a magic flute which can attract people to listen to his confession.

videos.title: Aladdins Truth
videos.overview: Aladdin and his friends reach the place where he is about to confess. Zafar arrives in time and tries to defy that Aladdins truth is a hoax but Yasmine asks him to stay away and requests the people to listen to Aladdins truth for one last time.

videos.title: Aladdin's Failure
videos.overview: Aladdin was going to show the truth to all the people of Baghdad. At that time the ring from Anguthi starts to disfunction. Someone must have tampered with the ring's magic.

videos.title: Ruksar Gives Up
videos.overview: Aladdin gets disrespected by everyone. He is extremely sad and moreover, his mother also turns her back on him. He is helpless and leaves, promising never to return.

videos.title: Gulbadan Tries To Save Aladdin
videos.overview: Jinoo tries to kill Aladdin on order from Zafar. Aladdin is in trouble and is hanging from a cliff. His friends are looking out for him. At that time Gulbadan, who knows the truth about Aladdin comes to help him.

videos.title: Gullu Learns Everything
videos.overview: Aladdins brother, Gullu gets to know all the secrets about Aladdin. He gets to know about the Jinns. He also knows about magic and is a part of their gang now.

videos.title: Zafars Leverage
videos.overview: Yasmine tries experimenting to find out the truth. On the other hand, Jinoo and Zafar discuss how they ensured the failure of Aladdins plan. He also keeps Yasmine and Ruksars lives as leverage against Aladdin.

videos.title: Yasmine Begins To Believe
videos.overview: Aladdin tells Zafar that he will go away to save his mother and his love. Aladdin comes to Yasmine to say goodbye. Yasmine tells him that she believes him and doesnt want him to go.

videos.title: Aladdin Prepares His Team
videos.overview: Aladdin talks to all his team members assembled to unmask Zafar. Later while discussing Gullu joins them and asks Aladdin to make him one of his team members so that he will be able to help them.

videos.title: Ruksars Reminiscences
videos.overview: Ruksar is alone and misses his son, Aladdin. She remembers the times when she taught Aladdin the values of life. She has a bittersweet time reminiscing the memories. On the other hand, Jinoo is busy with something else.

videos.title: Yasmine Rattles The Facts
videos.overview: Yasmine learns that Junaid is Jinoo through the Truth Goggles. Thereafter, she starts rattling the facts that had happened the night her father died. She goes to the store and finds the fake beard used by Muchchar.

videos.title: Zafar Is Almost There
videos.overview: Yasmine digs deeper into the facts and gets to the Golden Tower. There she is stuck by the traps set by Jinoo. Jinoo and Zafar perform the ritual and they reach the gate. Zafar is very close to his dream.

videos.title: Face The Demon
videos.overview: Yasmine is in trouble but Ali and his friends save her and escape without being noticed. Zafar and Jinoo enter the gate and find trouble there. They see a demon so powerful that even Jinoo is scared.

videos.title: The Devil Is Released
videos.overview: Jinoo and Zafar meet the devil inside the gates. The devil tries to kill them but they escape. However, they leave the gates open when they left. The devil can leave the confinement now.

videos.title: The Hallucinating Smoke
videos.overview: After Zafar leaves the gates open and escapes, Heblish the demon escapes. From the gates, a certain smoke os released that makes everyone troubled. Ali, his friends, and even Zafar feel the effects.

videos.title: Yasmine Wants To Punish Zafar
videos.overview: Iblis is free and wants to poison the air. He wants to destroy Baghdad. Yasmine returns to her room to get her sword and goes on to kill Zafar. Aladdin tries to get to her before she leaves but fails. Aladdin and his friends go on to help Yasmine.

videos.title: Iblis Has A Weakness
videos.overview: Zafar and Jinoo try to get the key from Iblis but they fail. Ali is captured by Naznin but he escapes. Ali finds Yasmine and tries to stop her from killing Zafar just yet. The darkness and night is the weakness of Iblis.

videos.title: Yasmine Gets Aladdin Back
videos.overview: Ali is hurt in the throat and is unable to speak. Yasmine tries to kill him but at the nick of time, she realizes that it is none other than Aladdin who has been disguised as Ali for all this time. They are extremely happy and they want to punish Zafar together.

videos.title: Iblis Releases The Poison
videos.overview: Yasmine and Aladdin catch up on what happened all this time. Aladdin brings Yasmine to make her meet his friends. Iblis releases the poison into the water of Baghdad. It poisons the waterbodies in the city.

videos.title: Preparations To Prevent Danger
videos.overview: Aladdin, Yasmine, Aladdins friends, and Gulbadan are together and they want to stop Zafar. They divide the responsibilities among themselves and get to work. They want to stop the poisoned water from contaminating all the water bodies.

videos.title: Aladdin Encounters Iblis
videos.overview: Aladdin goes to the main water source of Baghdad. He meets Iblis over there and Iblis starts attacking him. After a while, Aladdin understands the weakness that Iblis has and he escapes. Yasmine makes Zafar work.

videos.title: Exploiting Desperate People
videos.overview: Yasmine and Aladdin find out the truth about Iblis and also get the map to track him down. They now realize the true source of the poisoned water. On the other hand, Nazneen and her husband are exploiting desperate people and selling water to them.

videos.title: Sticking To The Plan
videos.overview: Nazneen is scared and she is stopped from doing wrong. On the other hand, Yasmine goes on to check up on Ruksar Khala. Aladdin gets a book that will help him to get rid of Iblis. They manage to get through with the plan.

videos.title: Decoding The Mystery
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine try to decode the way to defeat Iblis with the help of the old book from the library. A few of the pages fly away and they retrieve them. Zafar carries on with his evil plans.

videos.title: Playing With Zafars Mind
videos.overview: Yasmine and Aladdin pretend to not know each other and play the usual game. Aladdin poses as Ali and Yasmine treat him rudely. Zafar is caught in the storm and is confused.

videos.title: Yasmines Prayer Brings Back Water
videos.overview: Yasmine, Aladdin, and Zafar go to the water source and the person with the cleanest soul has to pray for the water to come back. Yasmine prays honestly and her prayer is heard. The source is full of water and the water problem gets solved.

videos.title: Fighting Iblis Together
videos.overview: Zafar and Jinoo are already trying to kill Iblis but it is difficult for them. Aladdin, Yasmine, and their gang come up for their help. Together they try to end Iblis forever.

videos.title: Zafar Escapes With The Key
videos.overview: Aladdin and Zafar were stuck because Iblis had made Yasmine and Jinoo hostages. Aladdin throws his poison on Iblis and he dies. On the process, the poison touches Jinoo as well and he is in pain. Zafar sees the chance and escapes with the key.

videos.title: Jinoos Fight Within
videos.overview: Jinoo has a storm inside his mind. He keeps transitioning from the dark Jinoo to the good Jinoo. The process is very hard for him. On the other hand, Zafar opens the second gate.

videos.title: Zafar Warns Jinoo
videos.overview: Zafar is all set to reach the 2nd gate and unlock the same but Jinoo becomes trouble for him as he keeps on turning into a better Jinoo. Zafar scolds Jinoo and exploits him so that he can reach the gate as soon as possible. Aladdin sees the condition of Jinoo and gets worried.

videos.title: Ransacking The Treasure
videos.overview: Aladdin and his friends ransack the treasure box and try to find something that can help Jinoos situation. At last, they find something that can help. Aladdin disguises himself as the doctor and goes on to check Jinoos condition.

videos.title: Saving Jinoo From Zafar
videos.overview: Aladdin tries to get Nazneen and Zafar away while he tries to help Jinoo. Later Yasmine also comes to help him out. Zafar tries to get them away but Anguthi helps them to remain in the room.

videos.title: Jinoo Is Awake
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine manage to get Nazneen as well as Zafar out of the room. Aladdin and his friends pray for Jinoo. later Aladdin puts the Moon-Stone on Jinoos neck. Jinoo is in and out of conscience.

videos.title: The Moon Mark
videos.overview: Jinoo wakes up and the moon mark on his neck starts to work. Chacha tells Aladdin that it will take a long time for Jinoo to recover completely. Jinoo is shifting from the good one to the bad one.

videos.title: Jinoo Disobeys Zafar
videos.overview: Zafar mistreats Jinoo and ensures that he remains in his limits. Zafar even slaps Jinoo and orders him to open the second gate of Raaz-E-Kainat. Jinoo denies to follow the order and speaks up to Zafar.

videos.title: Prayers And Fasting
videos.overview: Chacha informs the people that the next night was a special night and if a person fasts for an entire day, he will be performing the Roza-e-Maafi. The person is forgiven of his or her sins. Apart from that someone close to him or her has to pray for the person as well. Aladdin plans to do this for Jinoo.

videos.title: Zafar Is The Hurdle
videos.overview: Aladdins plan is working well as Jinoo starts to remember things from his past. Jinoo almost even confessed that he was only Shiek Jinoo but Zafar stopped him. Zafar is really troubled and wants to fix Jinoos issue. Jinoo even remembers Yasmine from his past.

videos.title: Yasmine Makes Zafar Apologize
videos.overview: Yasmine forces Zafar to apologize to Ruksar Begum. Zafar is furious because he had to bend down and apologize to someone else. Jinoo is almost back to normal and Aladdin is ready to execute the plan to make him completely okay.

videos.title: Zafar Follows Instructions
videos.overview: Aladdin and his friends carry out the plan and prepare for the prayer session to get Jinoo well. Jinoo is occupied so that he cannot eat. On the other hand, Yasmine tells Zafar a few things and he has to follow those instructions.

videos.title: Rukhsar Saves The Day
videos.overview: Aladdin, Yasmine and the others are in a tight spot as they don't have anyone to pray for Jinoo. At the right time, Rukhsar comes in and tells Yasmine that she also wants to pray. This saves the entire plan from falling apart.

videos.title: A Rough Time For Jinoo
videos.overview: Zafar continues his search for Jinoo and finally spots him arranging flowers. As he gets closer to confronting him, he is blocked in the path by a few vendors. Will Zafar catch Jinoo?

videos.title: Yasmine Saves Aladdin
videos.overview: While Aladdin and his friends are worried about Jinoo falling in Ammis sight, another shocker befalls Aladdin when Zafar confronts him out of nowhere. Will this be the end to their plans?

videos.title: Rukhsars Courthouse Prayer
videos.overview: Ammi walks into the courthouse trembling with fear about performing the prayer to the Lord amidst a big crowd. But, Yasmine steps in and boosts her confidence by saying that she should only focus on praying to the almighty and not the people around. Will Ammi be able to get over her fear and perform the prayer?

videos.title: Yasmine Stands Up For Rukhsar
videos.overview: When Zafar uses the opportunity to further insult Rukhsar for having stopped the prayer midway and seeks permission to announce the same to the public, Yasmine stands up for her. Despite the public creating a ruckus, Yasmine says that Rukhsar will finish the prayer. Will she be able to do so?

videos.title: Jinoo Is Back
videos.overview: Rukhsar is fine and gets back to singing the hymns. Aladdin goes to look for Jinoo and finds that he has changed back completely into the old Jinoo that he used to know. Aladdin Is very happy and so is Jinoo.

videos.title: The Gang Reunites
videos.overview: Jinoo is back to his senses but his only sorrow is that Aladdin is not his master. Later the entire gang comes and finds out that Jinoo is fine. They all reunite and everyone is really happy. Zafar has bad days ahead of him.

videos.title: Jinoo Meets Rukhsar
videos.overview: Jinoo misses Rukhsar and at the right time, she comes in with his favourite dish. Jinoo enjoys her company as well as her food. He almost spills the beans but handles himself somehow. A banshee appears at the Golden Tower and reaches the second gate.

videos.title: Snowstorm Hits The City
videos.overview: While people were cured of the poisoned water, the city gets attacked by a snowstorm which decreases the temperature increasing the difficulty. People are struggling to find warmth and shelter which caused due to the opening of the second door of hell.

videos.title: Battle Of Brains
videos.overview: Aladdin and his gang are worried and are doing their best to stop the snowstorm. They are also worried that Zafar will command Jinoo to open the third gates of Raaz-e-Kainat. Zafar does the same and Aladdin tells Jinoo to show him who is more intelligent. Jinoo plays along with Zafar.

videos.title: The New Princess
videos.overview: Aladdin, Yasmine and Zafar reach the new kingdom and wants to find a solution to the snowstorm at Baghdad. They hide and get to the castle and later instead of being hostile, the hosts are welcoming. They get to know that either Aladdin or Zafar will now have to marry the Princess of that empire.

videos.title: Aladdin's New Game
videos.overview: The Sultana wants to marry Aladdin and not Zafar. Yasmine tries to wave her away but she is stubborn. Aladdin, on the other hand, accepts her proposal and is ready to marry her. However, this is a game that Aladdin is playing and tells the plan to Yasmine.

videos.title: Yasmine Is Jealous
videos.overview: Sultana Enters Aladdin's room while Yasmine was present beforehand and listens to them secretly. On the other hand, Sultana is happy that she is getting married to Aladdin and presents him with the outfit for Mehendi Ceremony. Later Yasmine Enters the room and denies Aladdin to wear the outfit.

videos.title: Sultanas Mehendi Ceremony With Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin reaches the function hall where everyone is waiting for him and Sultana to arrive, and just after few moments Sultana arrives and the Mehendi ceremony starts. Meanwhile, Yasmine interrupts the scene and tries her best to not let what is happening.

videos.title: Marriage Gets Preponed
videos.overview: Aladdins and Sultanas marriage gets preponed and is about to happen two days earlier. Sultana is happy and excited about her marriage but Yasmine gets jealous. On the other hand, Aladdin knowing Zafars evil intentions takes a step to rescue the kingdom.

videos.title: Fighting As A Team
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine blame Zafar for preponing the marriage because he is the one who will benefit from it. Aladdin and Sultana enter the holy room for the marriage ceremony. At the same time, Zafar and Yasmine join hands to fight the soldiers and try entering the holy room.

videos.title: Zafar Gets What He Wants
videos.overview: Sultana releases the Aatish-e-Aftab and they all start praying to it. Zafar orders Jinoo to release poison gas and in the meanwhile, he escapes with the Aatish-e-Aftaab. Jinoo ensures that he escapes with all the others safely.

videos.title: Sultana Wishes The Very Best
videos.overview: The Sultana is furious on Aladdin and Yasmine. Later when she learns the truth she has a change of heart. She also admires Yasmine for being such a great Sultana of Baghdad. Zafar brings back the sun for Baghdad.

videos.title: Zafar Loses To Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine together save Baghdad from the snowstorm. Zafar forces Jinoo to open the last door of Raaz-e-Kainat and Jinoo has no option but to follow his orders. But Aladdin and Yasmine use the golden stone to stop Zafar.

videos.title: Jinoo Is Captured
videos.overview: Jinoo disobeys Zafar and as a result, Zafar captures Jinoo back in the lamp. Nazneen watches this and asks for this weird jewellery on Zafar. That jewellery eventually takes Zafar to much superior power.

videos.title: Zafar Brings Trouble Again
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine are searching out for Jinoo as he is missing. On the other hand, Zafar seeks help from this mysterious woman to find Magician Mallika. Zafar goes forward with a mirror that he receives. The man in the mirror gets permission to torture humans in return of help to find Magician Mallika.

videos.title: Yasmine Accuses Zafar
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine find out that Zafar had forced Jinoo to do the black magic because of which Baghdad is facing trouble. Meanwhile, the green clouds are converting people into Pigeons. When Yasmine goes to Zafar to accuse him of the bad things happening, they realise that Aladdin has become a pigeon as well.

videos.title: Zafar Gets Questioned
videos.overview: Aladdin tries to help Rukhsar against the green clouds, but he gets attacked and converts as a pigeon. Being a pigeon, Aladdin irritates Zafar and Yasmine questions Zafar about Jinoo. Zafar becomes speechless, and later Jinoo is been called out from the magic lamp by Zafar.

videos.title: Aladdin's Problems As A Bird
videos.overview: Since Aladdin has become a bird, he is having a lot of problems. He wanted to see his mother and made Yasmine take him to her. Later, he stops Jinoo and Yasmine to fight Zafar, as they wouldn't be able to harm him. Aladdin wants to get back to his own body soon.

videos.title: A Special Date Night
videos.overview: Yasmine and Aladdin are discussing on keeping an eye on Zafar. On the other hand, Chacha and Anguthi are keeping Zafar busy. Later, Aladdin and Yasmine see Jinoo and Jinee Minee having a sweet moment. As Yasmine also wants to have a special moment, Aladdin takes her on a special date.

videos.title: Turning Into Zombies
videos.overview: Nazneen starts to use the Magical Mirror that she finds. The Magical Mirror tricks her and takes away her soul. Later, she becomes a zombie. The Magical Mirror wants more souls from Baghdad and plans to make this place one of living deads.

videos.title: Protecting Baghdad
videos.overview: Ali, Zafar and Yasmine plan on how to keep Baghdad safe. Aladdin almost loses his cool over Zafar and starts choking him. Aladdin and his gang plan on fixing the zombie problem. On the other hand, Gullu becomes a victim of Nazneen and turns into a zombie as well.

videos.title: The Army Of Zombies
