videos.overview: Gullu tries to attack Aladdin but Jinoo saves him. They see that most of the people in Baghdad have turned into zombies. Aladdin also plans to follow the army of zombies in disguise. Jinoo helps in his disguise and Aladdin goes on with the crowd.

videos.title: Handling The Growing Trouble
videos.overview: Aladdin is walking among the zombies and has a narrow escape from being caught. A few of his friends are caught by Gullu after he wakes up and they are turned zombies as well. Aladdin gets the Magical Mirror and escapes the zombie parade with the help of Anguthi Chhap.

videos.title: Yasmine Realises About Fake Confession
videos.overview: Anguthi gets emotional and confesses Jinoo that he had given him negative energy. Jinoo also confesses to Aladdin and Yasmine that he changed Yasmine's father's confession in Zafar's pressure. Jinoo reaches Zafar's house in search of the real confession.

videos.title: The Search Begins
videos.overview: Jinoo keeps the Magical Mirror trapped in his room so that he can't spill the secret about Aladdin to Zafar. As the Magical Mirror tries to break free from Jinoo's trap, Zafar also starts to search the palace for it. Meanwhile, Aladdin and Yasmine decide to find Jaat-e-Zameen to retrieve Noor-e-Taj.

videos.title: Solving The Puzzle
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine are set to solve the puzzles to reach Jaat-e-Zameen to retrieve Noor-e-Taj. Meanwhile, Jinoo hides the Magical Mirror from Zafar to unravel the truth. Aladdin and Yasmine reach to the doorstep of Jaat-e-Zameen.

videos.title: Close To Noor-e-Taj
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine are on their way to find Noor-e-Taj. They see a tree with fresh red apples, and later find out that it's a trap by Shamsher, who demands them to answer three questions correctly, which would lead them to their freedom. Meanwhile, there's terror in Baghdad.

videos.title: Baghdad In Big Trouble
videos.overview: In Jaat-e-Zameen, Yasmine meets her great great grandmother who has been protecting the Noor-e-Taj all this while. Yasmine enlightens her about what's happening in Baghdad and how only Noor-e-Taj can stop all of it. Meanwhile, in Baghdad, Jinoo drops the Magical Mirror which Zafar has been searching for.

videos.title: Magic of Crown
videos.overview: Yasmine wears the crown and prays to save Baghdad. Zafar is furious about his defeat. Once again, Aladdin and Yasmine together win the battle.

videos.title: Sultana Of Baghdad
videos.overview: Yasmine wears the crown and prays to save Baghdad. The Crown does it magic and the magical mirror breaks into pieces. Once again Aladdin and Yasmine together win the battle and Yasmine becomes the Sultana Of Bagdad. Zafar is furious about his defeat.

videos.title: Daawat-E-Zafar
videos.overview: Aladdin traps Zafar into throwing a daawat for Yasmine. Zafar poisons the food with which Yasmine is going to start the daawat. What is Aladdin's big plan and with Yasmine's life at stake, will Zafar win?

videos.title: Zafar Ki Saazish
videos.overview: In the whole celebration as Zafar is waiting for Yasmin to take the first bite, Chota Jinoo starts eating the food first which makes Ginoo angry as he is going with Ali's plan to distract Zafar and it leads to a fuy food fight between everyone. A man reAlises that the chandelier is about to drop on Yasmine. Will Aladdin able to save Yasmin?

videos.title: Aladdin Reveals Zafar's Plan
videos.overview: Aladdin reveals a fact that shocks everyone. What did Aladdin reveal? Did he know about Zafar's plans? What is Aladdin's next mission?

videos.title: Zapped Zafar
videos.overview: Zafar is shocked to see his sister there and tells her that it was not his fault that the mirror has been destroyed and Zehar tells him then he needs to know who did. GB who had come to Zafar's room earlier had left the bunch of pictures that he had clicked from the crowning ceremony and the daawat. In the series of events, Zehar and Zafar get to know that there needs to be someone who would have helped Yasmine get the crown and Zehar gets her hands on the photos left by GB there and she is shocked. She tells Zafar that it is Ali who is helping the Sultana as per the photos and Zafar is zapped to know the same. He takes an oath to get the truth out anyhow with proper proof. What's his next plan of action?

videos.title: Zafar's New Plan
videos.overview: After Zafar gets to know that Ali is somewhere involved in the failure of all his plans along with Yasmine, Zafar along with his sister plans to take advantage of his family/toli to know the truth about him. On the other hand, Aladdin and toli plan on taking some time of their own to think of a plan to get the lamp from Zafar. Zafar with the help of chachi sends out secret invitation from his lamp and asks them to meet him at a particular place separately. They all reach the place and are shocked to see each other there together. Zafar is planning a new plan.

videos.title: Zafar Turns into Ali
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine look for the toli and can't find them. Yasmine tries to console him by saying that they must be in their zones of thinking about the plan and should give them some more time.

videos.title: Jam-E-Behroopiya
videos.overview: Zafar goes to Ali's room to find 3 devices. Yasmine enters the room searching for Ali and notices Zafar's shoes and as she removes the curtain, she sees Ali is standing behind. Zafar uses the 'jam-e-behroopiya' made by her sister.

videos.title: The Truth Of Ali's Identity Comes Out
videos.overview: As Zafar gets the devices, with the help of her sister she unleashe's the truth about their identity and all the jis come to their ji avatar and Zafar is shocked to see GOR Alive. Zafar becomes hundred percent confident that Ali is Aladdin now and Zafar along with Zehar plan on a new trick where in she creates a poisonous apple for Yasmine which will have only one way of getting out- the kiss of love. The truth of Ali's identity will soon come out through him saving his love. We end the episode where we see that the apple is consumed by Yasmine and chachi tells Zafar and Aladdin to visit a cave which has a witch who can give them the antidote to the poison.

videos.title: Aladdin Vs Zafar
videos.overview: As Zafar and Aladdin reach the cave, the witch tells Aladdin about the kiss of love which is the only solution for the problem. Aladdin falls into a daldal and it seems that Aladdin is just about to get engulfed, when Aladdin emerges as a hero.

videos.title: Timnasa And Zafar's Collaboration
videos.overview: We start the crossover episode from this day. After the open challenge given by Aladdin to Zafar- Zafar plans on doing something really big through Jinoo. As Jinoo and Zafar talk about it, all of a sudden a portal appears out of nowhere and we see Timnasa and Bhaymar come out of it. They introduce themselves and Timnasa tells Zafar her plan of getting the 3 precious stones which will help her control the past present and future and she would need Jinoo for getting the same. They both come to a conclusion that Timnasa will leave Bhaymar to turn Bagdadh into a no mans land and Timnasa can take Ginoo with her till then. Timnasa along with Ginoo step into the future

videos.title: Zafar's Fatal Agenda
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine think of what will be the next step of Zafar. Aladdin orders GB to get the pious thread for everyone in Bagdadh so that they can be away from all evil. Zafar is surprised seeing Bhaymaar's power as he creates a magical snake woman- Nagini who has the power to convert anyone who looks into her eyes into a statue and she can take anyones disguise. Zafar commands her to change into Yasmine. With the help of the jis, he gets Yasmine kidnapped. Now Nagini in the roop of Yasmine gets with Aladdin and plans the destruction of everyone.

videos.title: Good Vs Evil
videos.overview: As we see Yasmine in the roop of Nagini, Aladdin and GB get the whole of Baghdad in the underground hiding place. Nagini knows the secret place and Bhaymaar is helping her with the plan constantly.

videos.title: Aladdin and Vivaan's CoAlition
videos.overview: As Aladdin and Vivaan see the situation of the people underground,he moves towards ammi to see if she is okay and there is a hit and miss and Aladdin just manages to save ammi from Yasmine (Nagini). She asks ammi to hide at a secret place along with other woman. Vivaan and Aladdin through Bulbul chacha's lab get hold of a flute which they use to find out that Yasmine itself is Nagini and Aladdin is shocked to see the transformation. Vivaan tells him that they need to travel to the future to get Ginoo back and they get into the portal from where Vivaan came.

videos.title: Ateet Ki Jung
videos.overview: Zafar is successful in procuring all three time stones via Jinoo. Meanwhile, Baalveer travels back to the past Bagdad along with Aladdin and Jinoo. The heroic duo then fights Nagini and manages to turn her into stone using a mirror. Then, Baalveer destroys the three stones and defeat Zafar. It is then Aladdin learns that Yasmine was never captured by Nagini, but she is in some another grave danger.

videos.title: Chachi Blinds Ammi
videos.overview: To Aladdin's surpise, Zafar calls all three djis to protect him. Chachi blinds Ammi with the surma. After being told by Zafar that Ammi is in grave danger, Aladdin and Jinoo start looking for her.

videos.title: Zafar Challenges Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin and Jinoo finally find Ammi lying unconscious on the floor in her old house. They realise that Ammi has lost her eyesight due to some dark magical powers of the surma. When Zafar openly challenges Aladdin from stopping him from meeting Malika, Aladdin goes to Omar's old house looking for a solution in his study material.

videos.title: Aladdin Finds A Cure
videos.overview: While going through Omars written books, Aladdin overhears a few fakirs talking about a pious place outside Bagdad where angels listen to the prayers of the pure hearted. Aladdin persuades the fakir to take him with them. This fills Aladdin with hope and he informs his mother, Rukhsaar, about the same. Rukhsaar is elated. Aladdin and Rukhsar then leave for the place on a cart.

videos.title: The Cuing Zafar
videos.overview: Aladdin, stays empty stomach, but provides Ammi with all the nourishments. Zafar hatche's an evil plan of making a potion to reach Mallika, that would need sacrificing the djis. Though, he would also need to get Yasmine to meet his evil ends, a quick start makes him happy for the moment.

videos.title: Aladdin Meets Omar
videos.overview: Despite Aladdin's persistence and prayers, Ammi does not get back her vision. Losing all hope, Aladdin is about to give up when to his disbelief, Omar, his long lost father, appears in the form of an angel to help him. Ammi, too, feels his presence. Omar blesses Ammi who then recovers and sees Omar.

videos.title: Aladdin's Super Plan
videos.overview: Reunited Aladdin, Ammi and Jinoo plan their next step. Jinoo goes to Zafar. There, he sees Zeher for the first time. Zafar tells them that before the sacrifice he will have a grand celebration. Jinoo is shocked to learn that Zafar is going to sacrifice the three djis after the celebration. Jinoo tells the same to Aladdin. This shocks him and he promises that he won't let Zafar touch his djis. Aladin informs Jinoo of his plan and asks him to meet him at his old house. Aladdin meets Bulbul Chacha, where he gets an invention, a cockroach. A camera is installed in that cockroach, which will help Aladdin in pinpointing the location of the djis objects.

videos.title: Aladdin's Quirky Plan
videos.overview: Aladdin makes a plan with Jinoo and GB. All of them disguise themselves as Female Dancers. When Jinoo and GB distract Zafar and Zeher with their charm, Aladdin asks the three Jis to follow him to the other room. The cockroach shows them the location of the box with the objects. Aladdin and three Jis take out the box but at the same time, GB's wig also falls off. Will everyone know GB's truth?

videos.title: The Battle For Djis
videos.overview: Zafar identifies GB and shocks everyone. Aladdin, on the other hand, gets hold of the ring and summons CJ and once again, he becomes CJ's master. Meanwhile, Zafar and Zeher find that all the three Djis are missing from their respective places. They rush towards the place where Zafar has kept the che'st. Aladdin is about to summon JM, when Zafar enters the room and confronts Aladdin. A scuffle breaks out between them. In the end, Aladdin gets the bottle and succeeds in taking back the bottle. JM finally returns to Aladdin. Zafar is furious. He grabs the ring and asks Zeher the time of sacrifice. Zafar immediately blurts now. Zafar throws the ring into the potion and Gor gets covered up in flames. Aladdin and team are shocked.

videos.title: Anghuti Chhaap Burns To Death
videos.overview: The moment the ring falls into the potion, Anghuti Chhaap gets covered in flames. His whole body starts burning. Aladdin his friends are saddened to see this. They have a very emotional moment. Aladdin and others say Aghuti Chhaap their last goodbye. Rukhsaar witnesses the last visual of a dying Anghuti Chhaap. Keeping her emotions in check Rukhsaar, and tells Aladdin and others that its time to fight to end Zafar's story. When Zafar and Zeher reach there, Zafar realises that Aladdin has saved his mother. Zafar then reveals his next plan. He tells them the whole of Baghdad is waiting at the palace gates to question Ali's identity, who apparently is Aladdin.

videos.title: Black Smoke Kidnaps Rukhsaar & Djis
videos.overview: The day of the confrontation finally comes. Zafar gets Aladdin's truth out in front of the people of Baghdad. Zafar also tells the masses that Aladdin's entire family are of djis. He says that Aladdin's mother, Rukhsaar is the mastermind of the entire game, and alleges that whatever problems Baghdad faced, including Yasmine becoming a parrot, is because of Rukhsaar. Zafar's provocative words angers the crowd. They start beating Aladdin and his gang. On the other hand, Yasmine somehow escapes from the cave. She then heads in the palace's direction. However, before she can reach there, a black smoke engulfs everyone. Rukhsaar, JM and CJ get kidnapped. Only Aladdin and GB are left behind, fainting.

videos.title: Yasmine Fights Zafar And Zeher
videos.overview: Yasmine challenges Zafar to fight with her. Zafar agrees to do so. Both of them duel with their swords. After a spectacular swordfight, Yasmine corners Zafar and she is about to kill him, when suddenly Zeher charges in with her sword and throws Yasmine away. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Bulbul Chacha is the one who kidnapped Chand Changezi, Jinee-Minee and Ammi from the Crowd. Aladdin and Gul Badhan meet with them as well. Bulbul Chacha tells everyone that it was Jinoo's plan to save them. Aladdin promises Ammi that he will save Yasmine from Zafar. Aladdin, Chand Changezi and Jinee-Minee head out to save Yasmine. On the other hand, Zeher joins Zafar in the fight and she throws a magical potion on Yasmine which transforms her into a flower.

videos.title: Yasmine's Condition Shocks Zafar
videos.overview: Zafar is surprised to see Yasmine turn into a rose. He is shocked by the power of the magical potion. He yells at Zeher and blames her for transforming Yasmine into a rose, as Yasmine is the only one person that could help Zafar reach Malika. On the other hand, Aladdin, Chand Changezi and Jinee-Minee reach the cave and notice that Yasmine is not present there. Aladdin realises that Yasmine has freed herself and has gone to the Palace. When Aladdin reaches the palace, he notices that a lot of people have gathered around. Meanwhile, Zeher tells Zafar that Yasmine can be returned into her original self. When Zafar learns that Aladdin might come back to save Yasmine, he plans to publicly anounce that Aladdin and his Jis have turned Yasmine into a rose.

videos.title: Aladdin Gets The Rose
videos.overview: The people of Baghdad are searching for Aladdin and his genies. Aladdin and his genies find the location of the rose. It is in a garden. Aladdin wears the invisible cloak he got from Bulbul uncle to enter the garden. Aladdin successfully manages to obtain the rose but feels bad for Yasmine's condition. Thats when, Jinoo tells Aladdin that Yasmine can get back to her original form with the help of a seed of life located at Yunan. Meanwhile, Zeher also informs Zafar that a seed of life can help him reach Mallika. Aladdin and Zafar separately, leave for Yunan to find the seed of life. Will they cross each others path on their way?

videos.title: Zafar Creates A Sandstorm
videos.overview: Zafar and Aladdin cross their paths in Yunan. Zafar notices Aladdin carrying the rose with him. Zafar tells Aladdin that he will never be able to reach the Seed of Life. Zafar creates a sandstorm with the help of Zeher's magic. Aladdin and his team get stuck in the storm, while Zafar, Zehar and Jinoo march ahead towards the Seed of Life. The sandstorm creates a shock wave which cause the rose cage to fall off. At the same time, a huge rock falls on it.

videos.title: The Maze
videos.overview: Zafar reaches a Maze. He enters the Maze alone leaving Jinoo and Zeher outside as no magic users are allowed inside the Maze. After a while, Aladdin and his team also reach the Maze. Aladdin then enters the Maze alone. Jinoo is happy to see Aladdin and his team. Jinoo, Chand Changezi and Jinee - Minee create a magic to destroy Zeher's magical potions.

videos.title: Jinoo Is Exposed
videos.overview: Jinee-Minee and Chand Changezi destroy Zeher's apparatus. Now, Zeher is unable to make to an important potion. Aladdin and Zafar are stopped by Khatral, the guardian of the seed. Zafar manages to escape Khatral and he runs toward the seed of life. Aladdin outsmarts Khatral and destroys him. He runs towards the seed of life as well. Aladdin manages to get past Zafar and reach the seed of life first. Meanwhile, Jinoo, Jinee-Minee and Chand Changezi are celebrating their victory. Zeher secretly notices them, she learns that Jinoo was never on their side. Zeher yells at Jinoo and slaps him, she is about to hurt Jinee-Minee when Jinoo turns into his warrior transformation and he flings Zeher Away. Later, it is shown that Zeher is lying down unconscious when Zafar tries to wake her up. She tells him the truth about Jinoo. What will Zafar do to Jinoo?

videos.title: Zafar Melts Jinoo's Lamp?
videos.overview: Jinoo rejects to help Zafar in his ambition to reach Mallika even if it means death to him . Zafar and Zeher are surprised by Jinoo behaviour, but then they realize that Jinoo's lamp will help them reach Mallika as she made the lamp herself. If Zafar and Zeher melt the lamp, its magical metal will open the gates to reach Mallika. After listening to their plan, Jinoo decides to inform Aladdin about it. Jinoo reaches Bulbul Chachas House and meets with Aladdin, but suddenly, his body starts burning and he is unable to speak as Zafar puts Jinoo's lamp in fire. How will Aladdin save Jinoo?

videos.title: Will Bulbul Uncle Save Jinoo?
videos.overview: Aladdin and his team cannot find any solution to Jinoo's burning. So Aladdin asks Bulbul uncle for help. At the same time, Zafar and Zeher enjoy melting Jinoo's Lamp. Aladdin's mother pained at watching Jinoo burn, pours ice cold water on him. It causes Jinoo to get a bit of relief but Zafar and Zeher then decide to melt his lamp in molten lava. Jinoo's suffering grow higher. Meanwhile, Bulbul uncle discovers a device which can show the owner's thoughts. He places the device on Jinoo's head so that Aladdin and his team can get the location of Jinoo's lamp. Will Jinoo show his lamp's location to Aladdin in time?

videos.title: Zafar And Zeher Trap Aladdin
videos.overview: Bulbul Uncles invention fails as Zeher puts the lamp into the lava. Aladdin and company are now in a fix as to what to do. Jinoo starts throwing fireballs from his mouth, which start hitting everyone. Therefore, he leaves as he feels that he can hurt someone. Everyone is scared as Jinoo is in his dji avatar and is spitting fireballs. Somehow, Aladdin and GB save Jinoo along with CJ and JM and move on to their next plan, i.e., Ammi. Ammi encourages Jinoo to think and tell them where the lamp is, or where Zafar and Zeher are. Finally, Jinoo takes the name of Zeher's cave. While Ammi and others take care of Jinoo, Aladdin rushes towards the mentioned cave. Aladdin reaches there and manages to get the lamp out of the lava. Just then, Zeher opens a trap door for the lamp to fall down, so that no once can reach there. However, Aladdin uses his wit and jumps down. The trap door closes. Zafar and Zeher are on the upper floor, whereas Aladdin is below them with the lamp.

videos.title: Will Aladdin Find Jinoo's Lamp?
videos.overview: After his fall, Aladdin finds himself in a room of mirrors. He finds the reflection of the lamp in each mirror. This confuses him and he wonders that where the actual mirror is. Seeing no other way, Aladdin starts breaking the mirrors, but he fails in finding anything. Just then, Zafar also enters the same room. Meanwhile, Jinoo is still in flames. What will happen next? Will Aladdin succeed in getting the real lamp and saving Jinoo?

videos.title: Aladdin gets Jinoo's Lamp
videos.overview: Jinoo's lamp is still in the mirror maze. Aladdin and Zafar cross their swords against each other to obtain the lamp. After a while, Aladdin uses his wit to defeat Zafar and gets the lamp from him. Meanwhile, Jinoo on the verge of death, is waiting for Aladdin to return. While Aladdin's mother is concerned about him, Yasmine arrives at Bulbul Uncles house and tries to cheer Jinoo. Finally, Aladdin reaches Bulbul Uncles house and tells Jinoo that he has brought Jinoo's lamp with him. Aladdin asks Jinoo to get back inside his lamp, but Jinoo fails to do so. After a lot of struggle, Jinoo returns to his lamp and becomes Aladdin's genie again. In the end, Zafar gets furious at his defeat and tries to hurt himself, but Zeher notices this and tries to console him.

videos.title: Zafar On The Run
videos.overview: Aladdin and his team decide to catch Zafar, but Zafar and Zeher plan to run away to the Mucchad cave, as they think it is highly secure. Meanwhile, Yasmine interacts with the people of Baghdad. She announces a big celebration for her return and decides to expose Zafar in the same celebration. Later, Zafar and Zeher encounter two beggars on their way to the Mucchad cave. As one of the beggars accidentally pushe's Zeher, she makes a big deal out of it. The furious beggars then start walking towards Zeher and Zafar menancingly.

videos.title: Aladdin Exposes Zafar
videos.overview: As all the beggars hurl up around Zafar and Zeher, it is revealed to be Aladdin's plan to corner them along with Raees. On the other hand, Gulbadan is being followed by Aladdin's uncle and aunt to know where Zafar might have escaped. Later, Aladdin discloses the real identity of Mucchad in front of everyone as Zafar. Being exposed in front of everyone, how will Zafar run away from this situation now?

videos.title: Zafar Escapes
videos.overview: The palace is decorated for the celebrations of Jashn-e-fateh. Yasmine comes forward to give a speech. There, Zafar manages to disappear into thin air along with Zeher from the spot. Later, Aladdin asks Jinoo to teleport them to Zafar's hideout. Will Aladdin be able to track down Zafar?

videos.title: Queen Yasmine's Judgement
videos.overview: Aladdin gets hold of Zafar, and drags him in front of entire Baghdad. Yasmine tells everyone about Aladdin's iocence and Zafar's misdeeds including that of killing their king as well. After showing the whole evidence, Queen Yasmine announces a death sentence for Zafar, while Zeher is imprisoned.

videos.title: Zeher Hopes To Escape
videos.overview: As Zafar is given a death sentence, Aladdin's mother tells Aladdin and Jasmine that humans have no right to take away anybody elses life. Hence, they give Zafar life imprisonment in a strict jail and decide to keep Zeher in Baghdad. As Aladdin and Toli rejoice in the victory of the palace, Zeher thinks of a way to get out of the jail. Zeher notices that the bangles have gone black indicating the para to be active. She is hopeful of Malika coming to life.

videos.title: Zeher Finds Aladdin's Lamp
videos.overview: In order to stop Zafar from being taken to the jail, Zeher manages to run away. Meanwhile, Rukhsaar is spending some lone time, when Zeher hits her on her hand. Later, Zeher enters the palace and finds Aladdin's lamp.

videos.title: Para's Life In Danger?
videos.overview: Zeher leaves to free Zafar after she manages to get Para. Later, Aladdin finds the lamp and Jinoo realises that Para is missing. Meanwhile, Zeher succeeds to free Zafar, and they decide to drop Para in the volcano.

videos.title: Aladdin Corners Zafar
videos.overview: Aladdin comes and rescues lamp as Zafar and Zeher throw it into the lava. Yasmine and Zeher fight. This is Yasmine's ploy to keep Zeher away from Zafar. Zafar and Aladdin fight at the other end of the cave and Zafar manages to take back lamp. Zafar reaches a dead end hence has nowhere else to go and decides to fall with the lamp. The lamp goes into the lava and Zafar dies. At the same time, Malika turns from a stone into human form.

videos.title: Baghdad In Danger Again?
videos.overview: Malika is about to step outside the portal but Jinoo uses his power and closes the portal at the last moment. Aladdin , Yasmine and Jinoo celebrate their victory over successful stopping Malika from entering. But theyre mistaken as Malikas face appears in the sky.

videos.title: Will Yasmine Accept Aladdin's Proposal?
videos.overview: Baghdad is celebrating Jashn-e-Dilbar, the festival of love. Mallika enters Baghdad and starts following Aladdin. Later, Aladdin proposes to Yasmine. Will she accept?

videos.title: Malika Takes a Disguise!
videos.overview: Malika pretends to be Yasmine's aunt and writes to her, informing about her visit to Baghdad. She states that her kingdom was destroyed in an earthquake and thats the reason for her visit. Yasmine requests Aladdin to receive her. Aladdin and Jingoo go to receive the aunt, whos actually Malika in disguise.

videos.title: Malika and Aladdin Enter the Palace
videos.overview: Malika and Aladdin enter the palace. JM and Yasmine are having a conversation when a glass vase breaks and JM believes it to be a bad omen. Meanwhile, Jinoo and other genies realises that their magic has suddenly stopped working.

videos.title: Mallika Impersonates Yasmine's Aunt
videos.overview: Upon reaching the palace, Yasmine enquires with Aladdin about her aunt. She reminds him that he had to fetch her. Aladdin clarifies that she never turned up. Yasmine criticises her aunt. But Mallika, pretending to be the aunt, overhears Yasmine and comes face-to-face with her.

videos.title: Malika's Truth Revealed?
videos.overview: While on the palace tour with Aladdin and Yasmine, Malika senses that something is off. When she reaches the kitchen, she finds out that JM and CJ are performing magic in their genie form. Malika is totally shocked.

videos.title: Malika's Sudden announcement
videos.overview: Malika knows the advantages that Aladdin has because of his three genies and a magic carpet. She knows that she needs to be in his good books. During dinner, Malika announces the engagement of Aladdin and Yasmine. Everybody is surprised with this sudden announcement.

videos.title: Malika’s Hidden Motive
videos.overview: The engagement preparations are in full swing. Malika has a hidden motive behind getting Aladdin and Yasmine engaged. She reveals this hidden motive, which is to destroy the world using an instrument.

videos.title: Malika Faces A Hurdle
videos.overview: Malika requires a dagger in order to put her plan in action. Malika can use this dagger to make a genie tonic which can be used to turn people into genies. Malika currently has only one of the genie tonics remaining. So, she requires the dagger to make some more of it. But there is one person stopping her from actualizing her plan.

videos.title: The Dagger Thief
videos.overview: When Malika tells her story about the missing dagger, she reveals that the one who stole her dagger is from Baghdad as he had Baghdad's badge on him.

videos.title: Malika Hunts For The Correct Key
videos.overview: Malika is in search of the correct key that will bring her closer to finding the dagger. She uses her powers to summon all the keys to her room, after which all the people of Baghdad can't find their keys. Aladdin is confused as to how everybody can't find their keys in Baghdad. Aladdin and CJ enter Malikas room as Malika is looking for the correct key in her room. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Engagement
videos.overview: Ruksaar and Gulbadan decorate the whole palace for Aladdin and Yasmine's engagement. On the other hand, Aladdin struggles to find the perfect gift for Yasmine, but he ends up getting his mother's beautiful bangle for her. As Aladdin and Yasmine rekindle their love, Malika hatches a plan to take over Baghdad after Zafar's death. What will happen now? Check out in this episode.

videos.title: When Blessings Count
videos.overview: It's the day of the ring ceremony. The bride and the groom get ready for the big event. Just then, Ammi announces the arrival of a revered guest. Who is this guest that Ammi has invited? Why did Ammi invite the guest? Watch the episode to know what Ammi is upto.

videos.title: For Ammi's Sake
videos.overview: Aladdin is all set to swear on his mother as desired by Malika. But he stops just in time. Something catches his attention. What could it be that stops him from swearing? What will Malika do to make him do as she wants? Watch this episode reveal.

videos.title: Back To Normal?
videos.overview: Ammi is no longer her usual self. She has turned into a Jinn. Witnessing this shocking happening, Aladdin makes a promise. What is that promise? Does Aladdin have the time on his side or has the countdown begun? You need to watch this episode to know better.

videos.title: Ruins of Baltish
videos.overview: Aladdin, accompanied by Anghuti Chhaap, set about their journey to the old world of Baltish. Aladdin is in search of a person who can provide him with magic potion. Who is the person in question? Will Aladdin be successful in getting the magic potion? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Twin Twist
videos.overview: When Aladdin falls into the trap of Zeher, there is no one to help him, save one person. The person is none other than Zafar's twin brother. In order to establish this fact, Aladdin and Genie Of The Ring plan a fun quiz. Who is this twin? Will he be able to convince Aladdin of his mistaken identity? Watch this episode to know.

videos.title: Team Game
videos.overview: While Aladdin, Genie of The Ring and Faraz are catching up, Faraz reveals how his witch mother always knows about Malika. Aladdin confides in Faraz that Malika was at work again - this time converted his Ammi into a Genie. Faraz decides to help Aladdin. The trio head to Baghdad. To know what happens next, stay tuned to this episode.

videos.title: Malika's Menace
videos.overview: There is just one way in which Aladdin can get back his Ammi in human avatar. Aladdin needs to comply with Malika's condition and fetch her the special dagger. Left with no choice, Aladdin agrees to her whims and begins his journey towards the first adventure. Join Aladdin in his adventure, in this episode.

videos.title: Magic In The Fruit
videos.overview: Aladdin, Genie Of The Ring and Faraz finally have arrived at their destination- the jungle. But this is no ordinary jungle, it is a mystical and magical jungle. The magic soon transpires as Genie ends up gobbling a fruit. What happens next will leave you baffled. Don't miss this episode of magic and adventure.

videos.title: Dangerous Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin is no longer behaving like a friend to Faraz or Genie Of The Ring. He has become a dreadful creature whom Faraz and Genie have a tough time tackling. Faraz has one last option to make Aladdin alright, to which Genie does not agree. Meanwhile Aladdin is becoming a threat to both. What is Faraz's suggestion and why doesn't Genie agree? Watch this episode to know.

videos.title: The Khanjar Hunt
videos.overview: During an encounter with GOR, Faraz attacks Aladdin with a silver object. This attack wards off the magical effect and makes Aladdin normal again. Soon, the sun and moon rays help Aladdin locate the Khanjar. Aladdin gets his hands on the first part of the Khanjar. Watch the interesting turn of events in this magical episode.

videos.title: Aladdin Proposes A Deal
videos.overview: When Aladdin gets the first part of the Khanjar, he goes to the palace, but instead of handing over the part to Malika, he puts forth a condition. He proposes that he will retrieve and hand over all the parts of the Khanjar to Malika, only after she brings his Ammi back to normal. Will Malika agree to this condition? Will Aladdin be able to seal the deal with Malika? Watch this adventurous episode to know better.

videos.title: Blood Rejects Blood?
videos.overview: Omar is shocked to discover that Aladdin has joined hands with Malika. So, he confronts him about the same. However, when Aladdin lets his father know that Ruksaar was turned into a Jinn by Malika, Omar feels disheartened. Aladdin asks his father to help him find the missing pieces of the dagger to save Ruksaaar. Will Omar help him? Check out this high-on-drama episode to know more.

videos.title: Omar Refuses To Help Aladdin
videos.overview: Omar is unable to come to terms with the fact that Aladdin is helping out Malika. Even his reasons seem to be insufficient to propel Omar to help him. Aladdin tries to convince his father that he is only trying to save his mother, and the only way he can do that, is by handing over the dagger to Malika. But Omar backs off from helping Aladdin. What will Aladdin do now? Watch this episode to know his next move.

videos.title: The Secret Destination
videos.overview: Aladdin is shattered for not having his father's support, but nothing can deter him from saving his mother. He moves on to find the next missing part of the dagger. However, the quest is not an easy one and this time, he is faced with riddles to solve. Will Aladdin find a lead? Tune into this adventurous episode and join Aladdin on his quest of finding the missing part of the dagger.

videos.title: The Transformation Trick
videos.overview: Aladdin has set out on his quest to find the answer to the riddle. When he lands up at the palace, he meets Sultana, present there in the form of a cat. When he approaches her for help, she transforms into a beautiful woman and introduces herself as Tamanna. Aladdin wonders if she would know the answer to the riddle and asks her the same. But Tamanna uses her powers on Aladdin. See what challenge crops up in Aladdin's life after that and how he tackles it. Tune into this thrilling episode.

videos.title: The Cat Cracks The Code
videos.overview: Tamanna's magic transforms Aladdin into a cat and a further element makes him speechless. However, Aladdin decides to reach out to Yasmine and Faraz for their help. But he struggles to convince them that he is Aladdin, since he is under a spell. He manages to play around to get their attention and give out his identity. Once Yasmine and Faraz learn that he is Aladdin, will they be successful in helping him further in his mission? Watch this interesting episode to know what happens next.

videos.title: The Cats Devise A Plan
videos.overview: Tamanna is operating as per the directions from Omar. She gears up to transfer the dagger to a realm where no human can get by. At the other end, Aladdin and Yasmine, who encounter two more cats, try convincing them that they must find a way to reach Tamanna, as only she can undo the spell that's been cast on him. He promises to help them out in return. Will the cats buy Aladdin's word? Or are there more obstacles for him to encounter before he transforms back to his human form?

videos.title: Leaping Into Victory
videos.overview: Aladdin and his gang have been through a series of troubles to find the missing part of the dagger. Yasmine, who turns into a cat for Aladdin's mission to be successful, is happy, as Aladdin vaults over every obstacle and brings back the second part of the dagger. He heads back to Baghdad with his find. He begins to prepare tactfully for his next step in the mission. Will Aladdin find success again? Will he unearth the last missing part of the dagger? Watch this adventurous episode of Aladdin.

videos.title: An Enormous Challenge
videos.overview: As per Ammi's advice, Aladdin and his team follow the mountain shadow and get to the flower. But when Aladdin digs out the box, the impossible happens. In a fraction of a second, Omar appears and reveals to him that he has transported the last part to Farishta land, and no human can trespass that territory at any cost. How will Aladdin get to the last part of the dagger? What other challenges will follow him? Tune into this interesting episode to find out.

videos.title: The Puppet Land
videos.overview: En route Farishtabad, Aladdin and Faraz, land up in a strange land, which has only puppets. The leader happens to be a dwarf, who only wakes up from her slumber at the sight of human visitors. She thwarts Aladdin with lifetime captivity. Will Aladdin be reduced to a puppet? Watch this magical episode to find out.

videos.title: Turning To Puppets
videos.overview: The dwarf leader of the puppet land is all set to turn Aladdin and Faraz into puppets. Just in the nick of the moment, Aladdin comes up with an innovative idea, which may deter their transformation into puppets. What is Aladdin's idea and will it distract the puppet leader? Watch this nail biting episode to discover.

videos.title: Sinking Son
videos.overview: Aladdin is refused the part of dagger by his father, Omar. Aladdin is in dire need of this dagger for the sake of the promise made to his mother. Torn between the whims of his parents, Aladdin has no other option but to end his life. Will this step change his father's decision? Will Aladdin's promise remain unfulfilled? Watch this sentimental episode to know more.

videos.title: Little Choice
videos.overview: Omar has no other option but to part with the third piece of the dagger for the sake of his dear son, Aladdin. Aladdin returns to Baghdad with the dagger and meets Malika for the potion. Malika, being her sly self, turns the table on her opponent and there takes place a magical fight. Who will win this fight? Watch this episode to find out the fight outcome.

videos.title: Smoked
videos.overview: Just as Aladdin is about to strike Malika with the dagger, he starts getting consumed in an evil smoke. Malika rejoices as this will bring an end to Aladin's life. If Aladdin dies, will his Ammi ever be released from the curse of being a genie? Will Aladdin be able to come out of this cursed smoke? Watch this dramatic episode to find out.

videos.title: The Winning Stroke
videos.overview: Backed by a pure soul, Aladdin succeeds to win over the Shaitaan. This makes Malika a loser too. As she stands there transfixed at the scene, one wonders whether this will mean that Aladdin will be able to have the tonic to bring back his mother to human form. Will Malika give in? Watch this nail biting episode to know better.

videos.title: End Of Evil?
videos.overview: Aladdin finally manages to get the dagger from Malika and it's celebration time at Baghdad. However, what Aladdin does not know is that there awaits a nasty twist of events for him, something which he cannot even think in his wildest dreams. Watch this episode to find out more.

videos.title: Enemy Undercover
videos.overview: Seeing Faraz with the dagger, Aladdin demands to know the reason. Faraz reveals a fact which leaves Aladdin shattered. Aladdin's friendship with Faraz is under scanner. What does Faraz tell Aladdin to cause this level of astonishment? Watch this crucial episode to know further.

videos.title: Zafar - The Ayiyyar
videos.overview: Zafar reveals his new found sorcerer avatar with the help of which, no task seems impossible for him anymore. He uses this magical power to put Aladdin and the entire toli under arrest. Will Aladdin and his family be ever able to get out of this prison? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Jahannum Awaits!
videos.overview: When Aladdin disagrees to go with Zafar on a quest to obtain the 'Laal Sandook', Zafar informs him that after Omar handed over the final part of the Devil's Dagger to Aladdin, he has been banished to 'Jahannum'. And if Aladdin wants to save Omar, he should join Zafar on his way to hell. Aladdin realises that the stakes are too high, but will he participate in Zafar's hunt for the Red Box? Find out more about it, in this episode.

videos.title: Jinoo's Warning
videos.overview: As Aladdin and Yasmine plan to leave, they present a lovely gift to Ammi. Ammi is elated with the gift and promises that she will always hold it close to her heart. Meanwhile, Jinoo is not very comfortable with Aladdin going with Zafar and cautions him for the same. Watch this episode to know if Jinoo's warning will change Aladdin's mind.

videos.title: Genie's Vision
videos.overview: Genie of the Ring sees a scary vision pertaining to Aladdin and Yasmine. He is so perturbed, that he frees himself from Zafar's captivity and rushes to Baghdad to warn Aladdin. However, on reaching Baghdad, he gets to know from Ammi that Aladdin and Yasmine have already set about their journey. What vision does the Genie see? Are Aladdin and Yasmine in any danger? Watch this episode to know more.

videos.title: Hell Of Fire
videos.overview: The only way to save Omar is to get hold of the trunk. The search for the trunk takes Aladdin and Yasmine to the hell of fire. Once there, they find that the trunk is being guarded by a deadly creature. Can they defeat the guard and get hold of the trunk? You can get the answer as you watch the episode, stay tuned!

videos.title: Trunk Twister
videos.overview: As Aladdin and Yasmine reach jahannum, they encounter a deadly dragon that is protecting the laal sandook. The dragon is killed and they finally get the trunk. Zafar, true to his promise, releases Omar after getting the trunk. Omar is furious at Aladdin for letting Zafar have the magic trunk. Did Aladdin really part away with that important trunk or is there a twist in the offing? Watch this episode to find out how the mystery unfolds.

videos.title: A New Chapter Begins
videos.overview: Before Zafar could use Aladdin to trace the red box, Omar does the unexpected. He puts a mark of the moon and a star on Aladdin and Yasmine respectively, and pushes them into the lava. A defeated Zafar returns to Baghdad and casts a spell which makes everyone, including Rukhsar, forget about Aladdin and Yasmine. But in a far away kingdom, two babies are born with the same mark of the moon and a star. Have Aladdin-Yasmine taken a rebirth?

videos.title: Aladdin And Kaala Chor
videos.overview: Aladdin's father has set a target for him to catch the Kaala Chor. While roaming on the streets, Aladdin chances upon Kaala Chor. The meeting is memorable. Meanwhile, Zafar ropes in Ammi to fulfil his evil intention of finding a pawn for his mission. What happens when Aladdin meets Kaala Chor? What is Zafar upto? Watch this episode to know the twists in the story.

videos.title: A Bait For The Kaala Chor
videos.overview: While Zafar is trying to use Ammi's pathshala to get an Aladdin-like person to carry out his evil deeds, Ammi's mind has other thoughts. On the other hand, the King never forgets to remind Aladdin about catching the Kaala Chor. To honour his father's order, Aladdin thinks of a way to tempt the Kaala Chor to come out in the open, so that he can be caught red-handed. What is Ammi thinking? Will Aladdin's plan work? Watch this high-on- drama episode to know better.

videos.title: Anguthi Chhaap's Captive Life
videos.overview: Aladdin sees flashes from the past whenever he is in close proximity to Yasmine. On the other hand, Zafar, in Baghdad, has held Genie of the Ring captive. But, Genie is pretending to suffer from a memory loss. However, he knows the crucial information which may prove too costly for Zafar. What is Aladdin going through? What is Genie's secret? Watch this episode to know better.

videos.title: Yasmine Nabbed
videos.overview: Aladdin finally succeeds in catching the Kaala Chor red handed and brings her to the mahal. The Sultaan, however, makes a shocking announcement. Meanwhile in Baghdad, Zafar is inching closer to finding his sidekick from the paathshala. What does the Sultaan declare? Will Zafar get lucky this time? Catch all the drama in this episode.

videos.title: In Search Of The Taaj
videos.overview: After being asked to leave the Kingdom of Turkistan, Aladdin and Yasmine are left with the solo choice of finding the Taaj. However, both are clueless about the right destination and end up tussling with one another. Meanwhile, Anguthi Chhaap, seeing a vision, plans to lend a helping hand to the oblivious Aladdin and Yasmine. What is Anguthi Chhaap's plan? Will Aladdin and Yasmine discover their correct destination?

videos.title: The Forgotten Friend
videos.overview: Anguthi Chhaap, in his disguise, guides Aladdin and Yasmine to Baghdad. But after traveling for a while, Anguthi Chhaap implements his next step. He changes the route and instead takes them to a cave. This cave houses such a surprise, seeing which Aladdin and Yasmine will remain jaw dropped. Meanwhile, the countdown at Baghdad has begun. What do they get in the cave? What is Baghdad awaiting for? Watch the episode as the answers are hidden right here.

videos.title: An Aqaa In The Making
videos.overview: After facing numerous stumbling blocks on their way, Aladdin and Yasmine finally lay their hands on the magic lamp inside the cave. As Aladdin starts rubbing the lamp, he dons the hat of an Aqaa and is in for a pleasant surprise. Watch this episode to find out all about the lamp story and much more.

videos.title: Here Comes Jinoo!
videos.overview: Jinoo turns out to be a cool dude who is always high on the banter quotient. Aladdin and Yasmine along with Jinoo start flying on the magic carpet. Parallelly, the countdown of Zafar's hunt for a new Aladdin has begun. Where will the magic carpet take the trio? How far is Zafar from getting his desired version of Aladdin? Watch this episode to get the answers.

videos.title: After 18 Years
videos.overview: Finally, Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo reach the kingdom of Baghdad and reminisce about their past life. Whereas, Rukhsar arrives in a market of Baghdad to buy some groceries. As Aladdin strolls through the same market, he coincidentally stands next to his loving Ammi. Will he remember her? Will both of them encounter each other? Find out in this highly-dramatic episode.

videos.title: Ammi Meets Aladdin
videos.overview: Ammi and Aladdin seem to be sharing a completely different equation with each other which is nothing like the old times. Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo are focussed on their mission to grab the Taaj from the palace of Baghdad. Zafar, on the other hand, wants Aladdin to fail in his mission. Eyeing the lamp are Chacha - Chachi, who as you rightly guessed, are thieves. How is Zafar planning to stop Aladdin from laying his hands on the Taaj? Will Chacha and Chachi prove to be expert thieves? Stay tuned.

videos.title: Deal Struck Between Opponents
videos.overview: Chacha and Chachi succeed in their ordeal of stealing the magical lamp from Aladdin. Seeing the lamp missing, Aladdin and his toli set about to find Chacha-Chachi's hidden den where the lamp is likely to be found. Luck seems to favour Aladdin and he catches the thief -couple red handed. Fearing that their secret will be out, Chacha and Chachi offer crucial help to Aladdin in lieu of him keeping their secret intact. This help is likely to take Aladdin one step closer to the Taaj. Keep watching!

videos.title: Zafar's Naya Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo finally set foot in the school which is managed by Ammi. After some hide and seek moments, they are caught by Ammi, who orders them to be out of the premises. On the other hand, Zafar arrives at the school, hopeful of finding his Naya Aladdin once and for all. Will Zafar's wait to find Aladdin finally end? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Yasmine’s Sensual Dance
videos.overview: It is the day of the competition in Baghdad. Aladdin and toli are all set to get the Taaj that day. As per plan, Yasmine plans for a sensual dance to confuse Zafar so that they can inch closer to the Taaj. As luck would have it, by the end of the performance, she trips, hits her head and faints. Although Aladdin and Jinoo manage to whisk her out from there, they now need to come up with a better plan. Will they get another chance?

videos.title: Zafar Attacks Rukhsar
videos.overview: While Aladdin tries his best to get hold of the crown using Jinoo's magical rope, Zafar fumes in anger, as both Koyal and Shefaan fail in the competition. Furious, he throws a bomb towards Rukhsar, but Aladdin saves her just in time. This fuels Zafar's anger and he moves towards Aladdin. Will Zafar and Aladdin come face-to-face? Watch to know.

videos.title: A Great Revelation For Zafar
videos.overview: Zafar is curious to find out who is Ammi's saviour. But when he sees the face of the boy, Zafar is shell-shocked! He cannot believe what he sees, because before him, stands Aladdin, accompanied by Yasmine and Jinoo. The magical mirror reveals to him the entire story of Aladdin and Yasmine's rebirth and their journey to Baghdad. Tune in to this dramatic episode and find out how Zafar digests the resurfacing of his greatest enemy, Aladdin.

videos.title: Aladdin, The Chosen One
videos.overview: Aladdin and his toli introduce themselves to Shefaan and Koyal, outside the school and there's tashan between the two groups. On the other hand, Rukhsar is irritated with Aladdin's team as they create nuisance. However, Zafar summons Rukhsar and Aladdin, and asks Rukhsar to train Aladdin. Zafar claims that Aladdin is the chosen one and will accompany him on the mission to find the black lamp. But will Rukhsar agree to train Aladdin? Find out in this exciting episode.

videos.title: Rukhsar's Task For Aladdin
videos.overview: Reluctant to train him, Rukhsar assigns a task to Aladdin. She asks him to compete with his opponents to pick up the legendary hammer. And she also informs him that according to the old legends, whoever could pick up the hammer, was considered to be the real chosen one. However, looking at Aladdin's struggle to keep up with Rukhsar's training, Anguthi Chhaap takes matters into his own hands. Will Aladdin pass Rukhsar's test? Watch this highly-entertaining episode to find out.

videos.title: Zafar's Taaj
videos.overview: Genie of the Ring has planned to take Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo to an ethereal place. It is a pink lake where a tremendously large statue of Zafar with his taaj stands tall. In order to acquire the taaj from the statue, they need to cross the lake. And crossing it, requires walking on water, a skill only Rukhsar Begum can teach them. Will Aladdin be able to convince her to teach them the trick? Watch this episode to see if Aladdin makes it.

videos.title: The Black Lamp Mystery
videos.overview: Aladdin succeeds in lifting the hammer leaving Ammi in shock. Now Ammi has no choice but to train Aladdin in the Paathshala. Next when Ammi visits the palace on Zafar's summon, she hears Zafar discussing his evil plan with Zeher pertaining to the black lamp and manipulating naya Aladdin for the same. Ammi is horrified. What is Zafar's plan? Watch to know further.

videos.title: Ammi's Delay Tactics
videos.overview: When Rukhsar coincidentally finds out about Zafar's evil intention behind having Aladdin trained by her, she decides to delay it as far as possible. She devises a plan for the same and hosts a competition between two teams. Whoever wins the competition, gets to learn how to run on water. Tune in to find out if Rukhsar manages to keep Aladdin away from harm and who wins the competition.

videos.title: The Mystery Of Mehzabeen
videos.overview: As Ammi instructs them, the kids rush to the cave to find the udta hua lantern. They follow it and it leads them to a painting of a lady. It has a message written on it. The kids make a mistake that causes major havoc. They run away from the scene. What has the lady in the painting got to do with their journey? Find out the many mysteries by watching this episode.

videos.title: Mehzabeen And Aladdin's Date Night
videos.overview: The mysterious Mehzabeen is drawn towards Aladdin. On the other hand, Zafar's curiosity begins to mount as to who let Mehzabeen out of the Makbara. He turns to Rukhsar with his questions. Without flinching, she tells him that it is a part of their on-going syllabus. Meanwhile, we see Mehzabeen asks Aladdin out on a date, something he cannot refuse, but why? Find out what mysteries unfold when Aladdin goes out on a date with Mehzabeen.

videos.title: Jashn-E-Kabristan
videos.overview: It's Aladdin's date night with Mehzabeen. Set up in Kabristan, they are having a good time. The toli have followed them and are plotting to help Aladdin distract her so they could get the lantern. Finally, at an appropriate moment they ask her to give it. But is that all they need to do to get the esteemed lantern? Watch here in this episode.

videos.title: Mystery Of The Beating Heart
videos.overview: Mehzabeen agrees to give information about the lantern, provided Aladdin and his toli are able to find the spot that houses the beating heart. Aladdin and team divide in groups and manage to find the wall from which the heartbeat sound is coming. However, there lies the threat of Nazar Battu. Keep watching to know more.

videos.title: The Jungle Man’s Help In Crisis
videos.overview: As the ten feet tall monster, Nazar Battu, attacks Aladdin and the other team members, they somehow manage to save themselves and reach paathshaala. Aladdin receives help from a jungle man in tackling this giant. However, the kids venture out the next day once again to defeat the monster. It is no easy task, more so, when Aladdin is in his deadly grip. Who is this jungle man? Will Aladdin be able to topple Nazar Battu.

videos.title: Mysteries Of Manhoos Mehzabeen
videos.overview: Aladdin solves the mystery of the beating heart, which belongs to Bulbul Chacha. Hence, Bulbul Chacha finally meets Aladdin, and now can pass away in peace. Whilst Aladdin is solving the mystery, he does something that surprises him and Rukhsar Ammi. Later, Mehzabeen assigns Aladdin on the next task to solve another mystery. What could it be? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Mystery Of The Chopped Hand
videos.overview: Aladdin and his friends reach the nameless cottage to dig out the mystery of the chopped hand. After a lot of struggle and errors, they finally manage to spot the mysterious hand. Just then, the walking hand poses a threat for Koyal and Jinoo. What is going to happen to them? Will Aladdin be able to save them? Stay tuned to this episode to get answered.

videos.title: Jinoo And Koyal Kidnapped
videos.overview: The walking hand has kidnapped Aladdin's friends, Jinoo and Koyal. In order to save them, Aladdin seeks Yasmine and Sheefan's help. They reach the cottage and try with all their might to distract and defeat the walking hand, but in vain. The walking hand does something audacious which leaves Aladdin jaw dropped. Will this menace ever end? Continue watching.

videos.title: Legend Of The Walking Hand
videos.overview: While Aladdin is having a tough time to open the door to rescue his friends whom the walking hand has kidnapped, Sheefan accuses Aladdin of putting his friends' lives in danger. Just then, the jungle man appears and enlightens Aladdin about the legend of the Kata Hua Haath. Watch this episode to know the whole story.

videos.title: Aladdin Faces Ammi’s Anger
videos.overview: It is Shefan who informs Ammi that Aladdin solved the mystery of the kata hua haath not solely by himself but with the help of someone else. Hearing this, Ammi gets very angry and upset and comes to a tough decision. Her decision is beyond expectation as far as Aladdin is concerned. He does not know what to do now. What does Ammi do that makes Aladdin so helpless? Watch this episode to know the answer.

videos.title: Ammi's New Challenge For Aladdin
videos.overview: Rukhsar Begum is furious at Aladdin after being fed wrong information by Shefan. She refuses to train him and asks him to leave the paathshala. Aladdin is trying his best to convince her to rethink her decision. However, once again Shefan creates havoc and brainwashes her. In the fit of rage, Ammi throws an open challenge at Aladdin. What is the challenge? Will Aladdin accept it? Tune in to this important episode to know better.

videos.title: Aladdin's Asharfi Challenge
videos.overview: Ammi has challenged Aladdin to earn twenty asharfis by toiling on his own. Aladdin has accepted the challenge to appease Ammi without knowing that it is easier said than done. He realises that he is incapable of doing any task without Jinoo's help. Finally, he meets Tuglaq, who agrees to employ him. Who is Tuglaq? What sort of work will Aladdin do now?

videos.title: Shefan Upturns Aladdin's Mehnat
videos.overview: Aladdin, after accepting Ammi's challenge of independently earning money, has found a job in a brick factory. With a lot of effort, he starts making the bricks. However, just as he is about to stack the bricks inside the furnace, Shefan spills water on them, letting Aladdin's hard work go in vain. Shefan has further plans of causing trouble to Aladdin and Yasmine. What is Shefan upto? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Asharfi Challenge Goes Awry
videos.overview: Aladdin, facing all odds finally manages to earn the ten asharfi as per Rukhsar Begum's challenge. Elated he runs to the paathshala to meet Ammi. However, Shefan has other plans for Aladdin. What is Shefan upto? All well with Aladdin? Continue watching the episode to know better.

videos.title: Aladdin On His Own
videos.overview: When Aladdin is unable to show the asharfis that he earned, Ammi refuses to train him any further. Aladdin, too, gets angry and leaves from there, with a promise to learn walking on the water on his own. Meanwhile, Yasmine has hidden herself in a barrel that is going out of Baghdad. Will Aladdin learn the trick without Ammi's help? Is Yasmine alright? Catch all the drama in this episode.

videos.title: Aladdin Saves Badi Ustaad
videos.overview: After being abandoned by Rukhsar Begum, Aladdin has vowed to learn to walk on the water on his own. As he tries doing so, he notices Ammi getting drowned in water. He goes ahead to save her and in the process learns to actually walk on the water. Meanwhile, Yasmine decides to come back to Baghdad to locate a person named Mucchad. Will Aladdin earn Ammi's forgiveness? Who is Mucchad? Stay tuned as a lot is going to take place in this episode.

videos.title: Aladdin's New Trainer
videos.overview: Zafar, who is known for his evil and cunning ways, has one more game plan up his sleeve. He declares himself as the new trainer for the kids, including Aladdin. Hearing this, Rukhsar Begum gets very anxious and furious. Can she think of something to ensure Zafar stays away from Aladdin and other kids? Stay tuned to know.

videos.title: Zafar, The Tough Trainer
videos.overview: Ever since Zafar has taken over the responsibility of the training, there is chaos all around. The kids are fighting with each other to reach the training venue on time. And when they reach the ground, they are shocked to find a new and difficult hurdle placed by Zafar. How will they cope with this tough trainer?

videos.title: Zafar's Task For Aladdin
videos.overview: The kids are unable to withstand Zafar's atrocities during training such that only Shefan, Yasmine and Aladdin are able to make it to the last leg. Zafar then asks them to run and on reaching the right spot, awaits their last task. Aladdin makes it to the right spot. What task awaits him there? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Aladdin Gets Aag Baboola's Bangle
videos.overview: Aag Baboola,the monster, gives Aladdin a bangle and asks him to trace its owner. This bangle belongs to someone important from Aladdin's past life. Aag Baboola too has a shocking legend to his existence. As Aladdin accepts the monster's task, Shefan follows him with a bad intention. Will Aladdin find out the bangle's owner? Who is Aag Baboola? What is Shefaan upto?

videos.title: Aladdin’s Search For The Bangle Owner
videos.overview: After having fooled Shefan with a fake bangle, Aladdin flaunts the original one, only to have it thrown away by Shefan. As Aladdin runs behind the rolling bangle, he reaches an old house, which brings him memories from the past. Is there a chance that Aladdin will find the owner of the bangle there? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Aladdin’s Past Rekindled
videos.overview: While Aladdin is struggling with the mystery of the old dupatta and kangan, he realises it belongs to Rukhsaar Begum. He decides to go back to the house as he feels an unknown connection with its past. Soon, he gets puzzled by a picture found in the house as a part of the portrait of Rukhsaar Ammi. Whose picture is it and where are these clues trying to take Aladdin?

videos.title: Allah Rakha: The Vicious One
videos.overview: Aladdin succeeds in solving the first mystery of the kangan. He then is given another task in which Aag Baboola hands him a bioscope containing all the memories of the past. Aladdin has to unlock the same, to see what's inside. It is at this moment, that Allah Rakha appears out of nowhere and snatches the bioscope. Will Aladdin succeed in getting his bioscope back?

videos.title: Aladdin At Akupara's Mercy
videos.overview: Aladdin seeks Jinoo's help in getting to the earth's core. As they reach there, they come across a huge turtle with elephants on top of it, representing the balance of the earth from the old books. Mother nature, Akupara is the one balancing it. She gets quite upset when she sees two humans standing in front of her. Aladdin seeks her help in finding Allah Rakha. Akupara agrees to help, but says that first he has to pass a test. Tune in to know what's in store for Aladdin?

videos.title: Zafar: The Evil Plotter
videos.overview: Allah Rakha tells Ammi that the next day is laal chand ki raat, when no evil forces work. So, he plans to kill Zafar to end her entire struggle. Meanwhile, Zafar is all set to kill Rukhsar Begum and to take everything under his control, as he thinks she is a traitor. Parallelly, Aladdin, sees a vision of his Ammi getting engulfed by the fire with laal chand in the background. Aladdin feels that something bad is going to happen to his mother, who is still alive. What will he do next?

videos.title: Badi Ustaad’s Safety Cell
videos.overview: Allah Rakha tells Rukhsar Begum that he shall kill Zafar on the night of laal chand. However, Aladdin and Jinoo are back to the paathshala and Allah Rakha advises Rukhsar Begum to make sure that Zafar does not meet Aladdin. Badi Ustaad locks both Aladdin and Jinoo inside her secret prayer room and further asks Jinoo not to use his magic to escape from there. Will this plan work?

videos.title: Zafar Sets Haveli Ablaze
videos.overview: Allah Rakha steps in Zafar's way as he marches towards the old house. A fight sparks between them leaving Zafar weak as its the night of the laal chaand. Just when Allah Rakha is about to kill Zafar, Zeher steps in killing him with her poisonous potions. Later, Zafar spots Rukhsar Ammi in the balcony. The vision alone infuriates him, making him bomb the house. What's going to happen to Ammi and will Aladdin notice? Watch this episode right now to know more, only on Sony LIV.

videos.title: Ammi In Fire
videos.overview: Just when Aladdin is about to leave the house with Ammi, he catches a whiff of burning from the surrounding. His guess proves to be right, for the house has indeed caught fire. Parallelly, Yasmine sees Muchchad hurl a bomb towards the house, in which Ammi is trapped. What lies in Ammi's fate? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Ammi In Flames
videos.overview: Ammi regains consciousness and to her shock, she realises that the house is completely engulfed by the flames. She tries desperately to look for a way out of this blazing inferno, but in vain. So, she starts singing her dua as the last resort. At that moment, Aladdin goes inside in search of the kidnapper and is attracted by Ammi's song. Just then, her dress catches fire and she runs here and there, screaming for help. Will Aladdin be able to save her?

videos.title: Aladdin's Entangled Past And Present
videos.overview: When Aladdin learns about Rukhsar Begum to be his mother from the previous lifetime, he tries to confront her about the same. However, Anguthi Chhaap stops him in time and requests him to keep his discovery hidden from Zafar. After Aladdin finds out about Zafar manipulating everyone's memory, furious, he decides to have a word with him. What will happen now? Check out in this mind-blowing episode.

videos.title: Zafar Dared
videos.overview: Aladdin comes to meet Zafar with the sole intention of killing him. He hides a dagger behind his back. Zafar is oblivious to Aladdin's intention and talks of a new task for him. Ammi, meanwhile, has regained consciousness and wants to apologise to Zafar, for the sake of her favorite kids. Watch ahead in the episode, to know more.

videos.title: Aladdin-Yasmine, An Ugly End?
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine have a heated argument, which eventually results in Yasmine walking away, asking Aladdin to never utter her name again. Just then, Anguthi Chhaap visits Aladdin, assuring him the ring will take care of his future. Meanwhile, Rukhsaar Ammi gets emotional about having been harsh with Aladdin and promises Jinoo that she will rescue him from the lamp as soon as Aladdin comes back, so as to return to Aladdin, his lamp and his companion.

videos.title: Rukhsar Gets Kidnapped!
videos.overview: To witness the death of a parent is a great shock, be it for real, or in imagination. So, when Aladdin sees his mother's death in his dreams, he loses control. Only when he sees Rukhsar before him, he finds some solace. Rukshar warns him about Zafar's intentions and tells him that he is seeking a black lamp, which will change the course of the universe. She asks him not to support Zafar, but Aladdin denies her plea, which breaks her heart. Later, Rukhsar gets kidnapped. What is Zafar upto?

videos.title: Will Aladdin Hit The Bull's Eye?
videos.overview: Zafar kidnaps Rukhsaar Begum and stuffs her inside a sac and mounts it on a board, at which Aladdin is asked to aim his knives. However, Zafar lies to Aladdin that the sac contains sand. Aladdin starts aiming his knives one by one on the board. Will he end up killing his ammi unknowingly? Watch the episode to find out.

videos.title: Aladdin's Game Has Begun
videos.overview: Ammi thinks that Aladdin is not a good soul to be around, because of his proximity to Zafar. Aladdin, on the other hand, is only faking his support to Zafar for acquiring the Kala Chirag. His real intention is to seek revenge from the evil Sultaan. Watch the drama that unfolds, as Aladdin defeats Zafar in a game of chess and very smartly extracts information about the Kala Chirag.

videos.title: Zafar Under Aladdin's Deception
videos.overview: Aladdin succeeds in making Zafar believe that they should go to the sandalwood forest, to get some sandalwood, as the Kala Jinn loves this fragrance. Zafar agrees and in the avatar of Muchchad, he accompanies Aladdin. Yasmine too follows them. What is brewing in Aladdin's mind? Will Yasmine expose Muchchad this time? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Yasmine's Shocking Observation
videos.overview: The web of troubles and conspiracy continues in the kingdom. On one hand, where Rukhsar, under Zeher's spell, continues to be bothered by the weird speech curse, Aladdin and Muchhad reach the sandalwood forest to meet Zorappan. After an initial code language conversation containing animal sounds, Zorappan shows up. At this point, Muchhad has no idea that he is entering deep into Aladdin and Jinoo's trap. Yasmine is there too. When she sees Aladdin with Muchhad, she loses her cool.

videos.title: Unmasking Mucchad, Yasmine
videos.overview: After Yasmine successfully manages to knock Mucchad out, she tries to uncover his real identity. But, Aladdin does not like the idea and tries to stop her. While Aladdin and Yasmine get into a tiff, Shefan makes another attempt to unmask Mucchad. But this time, Jinoo regains his consciousness and turns Shefan into a snake with his magic. What will happen now? Tune into this episode to find out.

videos.title: Aladdin’s Plan Fails
videos.overview: Aladdin is inching closer to fulfilling his plan, and accordingly takes Zafar to the venue that is supposed to have all the sandalwood piled up. As they reach the spot, a shock awaits them, for the sandalwood is burnt to ashes. Aladdin miserably fails in his plan and Zafar is furious. Who is behind this destruction?

videos.title: Yasmine Creates Trouble For Aladdin
videos.overview: Evil Zafar wants to know all about Aladdin's plan, which is why he makes him consume a drink containing the truth serum. However, as Anguthi Chhaap was aware of Zafar's ugly move, he ensured that Aladdin didn't consume the actual drink. Though Aladdin thinks he has outwitted Zafar, his happiness is short-lived when Zafar traps him in a magical sphere. At the same time, Yasmine arrives and rats out Aladdin. What will happen next? Find out in this dramatic episode.

videos.title: Yasmine's Wiped Out Memory
videos.overview: When Zafar gets to know from Yasmine that she knows about Muchchhad, he realises that his major threat is not from Aladdin, but from Yasmine. Thus, Zafar wipes outYasmine's memory about Muchchhad. Aladdin, who is held captive behind an invisible wall, finds out that there is a room, in which Zafar stores all the memories that he erases. What will Aladdin do next?

videos.title: Aladdin Controls Yasmine's Senses?
videos.overview: Yasmine has been interfering with Aladdin's mission for quite some time. So, he wants to control all of her actions. But in order to do that, Aladdin, according to the magical book, needs to win over all five of Yasmine's senses. Although Aladdin starts with her sense of smell, dominating it is easier said than done. Find out if Aladdin gains control over Yasmine's sense of smell and the other senses or not, in this episode.

videos.title: The Yasmine-Zeher Swap
videos.overview: Aladdin prepares a concoction with the help of which he plans to swap Yasmine with Zeher. This is his ploy to break the inseparable jodi of Zafar and Zeher. Aladdin's jinn friends trap Zeher and Aladdin proceeds with Yasmine to fulfil his plan. But fate has something else designed for Aladdin, when Yasmine falls deep in water. What will Aladdin do now?

videos.title: Lovestruck Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin is left with no other choice but to dive after Yasmine into the deep river, in order to save her. Under the water, Aladdin gets mesmerized by her beauty and realises for the first time that he has fallen head over heels for her. Powered by his overwhelming love, will Aladdin manage to save Yasmine afterall? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Cracking The Code, Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin is resolute about helping Yasmine and saving her from Zafar's claws. Zafar, who feels betrayed by Zeher, unintentionally reveals a few things about Yaadon Ki Baaraat to Aladdin. In an attempt to dig more information from Zafar about the memory room, a challenging question pertaining to Yaadon Ki Baaraat stands in front of Aladdin. Tune into this dramatic episode to find out if Aladdin succeeds in his quest.

videos.title: Zeher Attacks Zafar
videos.overview: The appearance of Zeher-turned-mouse creates a nuisance, not only for Zafar, but for Aladdin too. He fears getting exposed, but his jinn friend saves him at the critical moment. Meanwhile, Jinoo brings back Yasmine's consciousness. Yasmine is annoyed and gets into an argument with Jinoo, thereby making him vanish from the scene. Later at night, when Zafar is sleeping, a cloaked figure comes and attacks Zafar with a knife, and to his shock, it's none other than Zeher. Why would she do so?

videos.title: Aladdin's Search For Yaadon Ki Baaraat
videos.overview: Aladdin decides to unfurl the mystery of Yaadon Ki Baraat and accompanying him in this mission are his two faithful genies. Aladdin's search takes him to a secret palace, which belongs to Zafar and no trespassers are allowed in it. Seeing Aladdin steal her boots, Yasmine tail-gates him, all the way to the palace. Will Aladdin get his answer? What if Zafar gets an inkling about Aladdin's intention? Watch this dramatic episode to get answered.

videos.title: Hide And Seek With Aladdin-Yasmine
videos.overview: After entering the palace, Aladdin and Yasmine get into another secret room through the room of mirrors. The room is nearly empty except for a single cupboard. It arouses their curiosity and they walk towards the cupboard. It's at that moment, Zafar enters the room, taking Aladdin and Yasmine by surprise. Finding no other place, they hide inside the cupboard. Zafar starts looking around. Will he find Aladdin and Yasmine?

videos.title: Aladdin In Mystical Snow World
videos.overview: When Aladdin discovers that there is a whole new space inside the magical cupboard, he is intrigued and decides to explore it. While exploring, he comes across three doors and only one leads to the right path. Surprisingly, Aladdin manages to enter the right door which leads him to a mystical snow world. Meanwhile, Zafar visits the snake woman, to know the name of his betrayer. Will Zafar succeed in finding the truth about Aladdin?

videos.title: Aladdin And The Memory Tree
videos.overview: Aladdin arrives at the mystical snow world and chances upon his mother. Thereafter, he learns about the memory tree. It is in this memory tree, that Zafar stores all the memories that he has erased from various people. Aladdin begins his quest for the memory tree, which proves to be a rather daunting one. On the other hand, Zafar almost gets to know the name of his traitor. Watch the rest of the story, in this episode.

videos.title: Aladdin Loses His Eyesight
videos.overview: The moment Aladdin touches Ammi's memory ball, he gets hit by a bolt of sharp light. This makes him lose his eyesight and he struggles to get out of the cupboard. Zafar, meanwhile, approaches the cupboard and danger looms large over Aladdin's head. In order to protect his master, Anguthi Chhaap takes a drastic step. What happens when Zafar finds out about Aladdin's quest? Tune in to this adventurous episode to find out.

videos.title: Aladdin's Eyes, Jinoo
videos.overview: Aladdin without his eyesight, needs Jinoo's help to tell him about the surroundings, so that Zafar doesn't detect his blindness. Jinoo hides behind his aaka's ear and goes on guiding him. But when Aladdin senses that Zeher wants to harm Yasmine, he sends Jinoo away to save her. Just then Zafar challenges him to a sword fight. Can Jinoo save Yasmine? How will Aladdin manage without his sight? Stay tuned to this episode to find out.

videos.title: Yasmine Blackmails Zeher
videos.overview: Yasmine accidentally sprays a chemical in Aladdin's eyes, when Aladdin and Jinoo try to rescue her from Zeher's captivity. This brings back his eyesight. The three of them then hatch a plan, to ensure that Zeher frees Yasmine by herself. Yasmine blackmails Zeher with the secret of Zafar once being a mere wazir, and that it is Zeher who has blurted out this truth, in her sleep-walk. Zeher gets uneasy hearing this. Will she succumb to Yasmine's blackmails and free her? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Alasmine
videos.overview: Zafar has plotted hard to sacrifice Anguthi Chhaap in order to get the black lamp, but the blood rain ruins his plans. This frustrates him and he marches to the snake witch for clarification. She tells Zafar that he is cursed. Later, the snake witch meets Aladdin, and gives him a clue to find his destiny. It takes Aladdin to a flight of magical stairs, which then leads him to a room with a big frame, and when Aladdin unveils it, he is shocked to find Yasmine's portrait in Sultana's attire.

videos.title: Baghdad's Sultana,Yasmine?
videos.overview: Aladdin gets confused on learning that Yasmine was the Sultana of Baghdad in her previous life. So, he requests Jinoo to help him solve the puzzle. Aladdin feels relieved when Jinoo decides to transport him to Anguthi Chhaap. Elsewhere, Zafar discovers Yasmine's intentions of finding more about the Sultana of Baghdad. So, he decides to hold her hostage for the rest of her life, in a desert.

videos.title: Aladdin, Off To The Past
videos.overview: Anguthi Chhaap transports Aladdin to Baghdad of old times, and shows his connection with Yasmine, who was then the Sultana of Baghdad, and Aladdin, the Kala Chor. Aladdin is amazed at this revelation, and wants to learn more. But time is ticking fast, so, he needs to be back to the present. How will Aladdin know more about his past?

videos.title: Furious Zafar, Resolute Aladdin
videos.overview: After learning about his past connection, Aladdin is wrapped in a bundle of questions and is looking for answers. Yasmine's struggle to find a way out of the desert grows intense, making her feel handicapped for a solution. Aladdin, who learns about this, decides to head to the desert to save Yasmine from Zafar's trap. Meanwhile, Zafar gets to know about Aladdin's movement, and gets enraged. Tune into this dramatic episode to find out what happens further.

videos.title: Aladdin's Kala Chor Avatar
videos.overview: Aladdin, with great difficulty, manages to convince a furious Zafar with reasons for saving Yasmine. Later, Aladdin disguises himself as Kala Chor and decides to go to the palace to meet Zafar. What is going on in Aladdin's mind? Tune in to this episode to find out.

videos.title: Aladdin Steals Zafar's Magical Glove
videos.overview: After learning about his past, Aladdin is prepared to knock-off his long-standing enemy, Zafar. He makes his first move by disguising himself as Kala Chor, and sneaking into the palace. Aladdin notices Zafar using a mysterious trunk as a gateway to the secret chamber. Grabbing the opportunity, Aladdin enters the chamber when Zafar falls asleep. Though Aladdin succeeds in stealing Zafar's magical glove, what will happen when Zafar learns about this robbery?

videos.title: Zafar Steals A March On Aladdin
videos.overview: Aladdin works his ways to convince Zafar to keep the box of memories in a magical cave, so that no one can lay their hands on it. Zafar takes his prized possession, and heads to the cave along with Aladdin. Instructing Aladdin to stay outside, Zafar tucks away the box of memories in the cave.
