Aladdin, eager to get his hands on the box, returns to the cave the next day, only to find that the doors have been sealed with Zafar's blood. Tune into this adventurous episode to know Aladdin's next move.

videos.title: Aladdin Breaks A Memory Ball
videos.overview: Aladdin enters the cave and Yasmine follows him closely. She confronts him about his interest in Zafar's sandook, and they engage in a heated argument. Aladdin, losing his cool, ends up breaking one of the memory balls, that is of Jinoo's. Jinoo is about to experience a strong reaction. What's it? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Zafar's Truth Uncovered
videos.overview: As Jinoo gets all the memories back, Aladdin opens up to Yasmine about Zafar's cruel intentions to wipe out the entire humanity. Ammi tells Yasmine to join forces with Aladdin to defeat Zafar, so that he cannot accomplish his cunning plan. Anguthi Chhaap informs Aladdin about Zafar's hidden powers. Tune into this thrilling episode to find out how Aladdin plans to strike Zafar.

videos.title: Aladdin In The Land Of Scorpions
videos.overview: Using the information given by Anguthi Chhaap, Aladdin and his team head out to meet the scorpion clan. Upon their arrival, Aladdin meets Zarina, a beautiful young woman, who has never ventured out of the clan. After making Zarina aware of his mission and Zafar's evil plan to carry out the atrocities on innocent people, Aladdin requests Zarina to join his gang. While Zarina readily agrees to be a part of the team, will all work out well for Aladdin and his toli?

videos.title: Zarina Saves Aladdin's Toli
videos.overview: Due to his growing suspicion on Aladdin, Zafar enters his room to find the magical glove. However, Anguthi Chhaap ensures that Zafar doesn't get his hands on the glove. Elsewhere, the merciless soldiers of the scorpion clan capture Aladdin and his team place them in front of a huge and deadly scorpion. But before things can go awry, Zarina, keeping her word, arrives to save the trio using her magical powers. Tune into this adventurous episode to find out what unfolds further.

videos.title: Zarina In Love With Zafar
videos.overview: Zarina crosses the magic portal and arrives in Baghdad to help Aladdin complete his mission. While Zarina is busy roaming in the market and getting a feel of the place, things go awry, leading her to Zafar. Oblivious to the fact that he is the cunning person who Aladdin was talking about, Zarina's interaction with Zafar sprouts feelings for him in Zarina's heart and vice-versa. What will happen when Aladdin will learn about Zarina's feelings?

videos.title: Zarina's Love, Aladdin's Enemy
videos.overview: Entrusted with the task of terminating Zafar, Zarina meets him in his chamber, but starts falling deeply in love with him. Though she hands him the rose, she has a change of heart at the last minute, and snatches the magical rose from his hands. Aladdin, who is watching this act, is met with a rude shock. Later, when Aladdin confronts Zarina, her silence speaks louder than her actions. Aladdin warns Zarina to keep away from telling Zafar the truth. Will Zarina pay heed to Aladdin's words?

videos.title: Zarina In Danger
videos.overview: Zarina, who is insanely in love with Zafar, meets him for the Nikaah. However, the musical night brings out Zarina's true identity in front of Zafar, as the drum beats turn her into a scorpion. Elsewhere, Aladdin and Yasmine are caught up in an ugly fight. What will happen when Zafar will see Zarina's true avatar? Tune into this dramatic episode to find your answers.

videos.title: Zafar's Tyrannical Rule Ends
videos.overview: When Zarina transforms into a scorpion, Zafar stabs her. But Zarina ensures that she stings him before dying. As Zarina's poison begins to spread in Zafar's body, he starts losing all his magical powers, and turns to a wazir like before. While Zafar is shattered, the people of Baghdad rejoice at the end of his cruel rule.

videos.title: Zeher's Zeher
videos.overview: Rukhsar finds out that she is Aladdin's mother. Evil Zeher makes the most dangerous poison and gives it to Zafar to use as a weapon as he has lost his powers. Yasmine memories come back and she realizes that she was wrong about Aladdin. Aladdin and Yasmine come up with a plan to defeat Zafar. What will they do? Will they succeed?

videos.title: Yasmine's Sense Of Justice
videos.overview: Jinn explains how Rukhsar plans on delivering justice to Zafar for his evil deeds. Yasmine quickly finds a flaw in her plans and says that the plan won't work on someone like Zafar. She decides to pull out a sword and deliver justice with her own hands.

videos.title: Zeher Loses Her Zeher
videos.overview: Aladdin is looking for Yasmine and stumbles upon Zeher and Zafar at the graveyard. They claim that they haven't seen her, and later check the coffin where they kept her, unaware that they are being fooled. Later, Jinn and Yasmine torture Zafar with hopes that he will lose his mind.

videos.title: Zafar Is Caught
videos.overview: All Rukhsar's plans are succeeding one after the other and Zafar gets caught. Later, he faces troubles as he is taken for his sentencing. However, Zeher has gained consciousness and won't back down without a fight.

videos.title: Zafar Twists The Truth
videos.overview: Aladdin finally gets Zafar to face the trial for his crimes. Just as Yasmine predicted, the worst happens, and Zafar twists the truth to avoid punishment. Meanwhile, Zeher has caught upto Rukhsar and Jinn.

videos.title: Zeheriley Duo Captured
videos.overview: Aladdin and Yasmine manage to free the captured Jinn and Rukhsar and help them escape. After leaving Ammi in the safety of the palace, Jinn returns to assist his aaka capture the Zeheriley Duo.

videos.title: Sultana Yasmine
videos.overview: Aladdin declares Yasmine as Sultana in front of the entire mulk. Meanwhile, Khalibali tries to kill Zafar in jail. Someone attacks Aladdin's mother and she faints. Later, Yasmine starts wondering if she has started falling for Aladdin.

videos.title: Rukhsar Hypnotized
videos.overview: Zeher and Zafar manage to hypnotize Rukhsar, and they use her to invite Fairoz to the castle so she could free them from the dungeon. Meanwhile, Aladdin realizes his love for Yasmine and tries to find the best way to confess it.

videos.title: Aladdin Proposes
videos.overview: Aladdin finally confesses his love to Yasmine, but Yasmine has a lot on her plate and rejects his proposal. Meanwhile, Rukhsar is still under Zeher's control and is executing Zafar's evil plan for revenge and escape.

videos.title: Yasmine's Taaj Poshi
videos.overview: After Yasmine rejects Aladdin's proposal, both plan to go their separate ways. Aladdin plans to leave for Turkistan after Yasmine's crowning ceremony. Later, Aladdin finds Chulbul tied up, who reveals that Rukhsar is under Zeher's mind control.

videos.title: Rukhsar Rescued
videos.overview: During Yasmine's taaj poshi Fairuz begins singing. Zafar's plans are on the verge of success as Fariruz's voice puts everyone to sleep. But, Yasmine who is lost in her thoughts and not listening to the song does not fall under her spell. Meanwhile, Aladdin has also discovered about Zafar's schemes.

videos.title: Zafar's Elaborate Trap
videos.overview: Ginn uses Zeher's medallion and potion to track her location. Aladdin and Yasmine quickly set out to capture the evil brother and sister duo. Meanwhile, Zafar gets into an arrangement with an old acquaintance to trap Aladdin and get rid of his Ginn.

videos.title: Aladdin Trapped
videos.overview: Shehezaadi puts on a display of her magical prowess and manages to catch Aladdin. She then creates a clone of Aladdin, who she controls and manipulate him into capturing Yasmine.

videos.title: Aladdin's Choices
videos.overview: Zafar gives Aladdin a choice to return to his loved ones by handing him over the kala chiraag. Soon, Yasmine and Haider, Aladdin's clone, reach home and realize that Aladdin is acting and talking strangely.

videos.title: The Palace Under Haider's Control
videos.overview: Haider manages to put everyone in the palace, except Ginn, under his control. Meanwhile, Aladdin tries to convince Sheherzaade to let him go but, she is too smart for him to handle. Back at the palace, Ginn also tries his best to free everyone from Haider's control.

videos.title: Aladdin Outsmarted
videos.overview: The face-off between Aladdin and Sheherzaade continues as both try to outsmart each other. Meanwhile, Ginn and Chatarpatar are trying to get Ginn back to Yasmine and Rukhsar's side. Haider continues to control Yasmine and Rukhsar and leads them to the edge of a cliff to throw them off it.

videos.title: Who Is The Real Aladdin?
videos.overview: Cheenu tells everyone what happened. Sheherzaade tells Aladdin only she can help him defeat Haider. Later, Cheenu and Yasmine try attacking Haider but, nothing works on him. Just then, Aladdin comes there and, everybody is happy to see him. Aladdin and Haider get into a fight and, everyone gets confused about which one is the real Aladdin. How will they find out the truth?

videos.title: Zafar's Warnings
videos.overview: Aladdin manages to free everyone from Haider's grasps after burning Haider's book. Later, Zafar warns Aladdin to make a choice - either hand him the Kala Chirag or watch his world burn.

videos.title: Aladdin and Yasmine Engaged
videos.overview: Yasmine realizes that she and Aladdin are meant to be together and goes down on her knees to propose to him. Meanwhile, Zafar and Zeher are working on becoming stronger and getting their revenge.

videos.title: Zafar And Zeher Make Their Moves
videos.overview: Aladdin infiltrates the lair because he was in possession of the pen. To let Yasmine in, Aladdin throws the pen but Zafar sweeps in and intercepts it. Meanwhile, Zeher, with her slaves, threaten Chulbul and asks him to deliver a message.

videos.title: Aladdin Turned Into An Old Man
videos.overview: In their quest to find the Kala Chirag, Aladdin, Yasmine and Zafar encounter a man with a red mask who claims to be the guardian of the Chirag. Meanwhile, Zeher's slaves manage to capture Rukhsar and Chulbul, and Ginn makes a promise to his older brother.

videos.title: Aladdin Breaks The Curse
videos.overview: After capturing Angoothi Chaap, Zeher forces him to do her dirty work to bring the Kala Ginn back. Meanwhile, Aladdin managed to break free from the guardian's cure and turns back to his real age. Zafar, Aladdin and Yasmine continue their quest to find the Kala Chirag.

videos.title: Yasmine Defeats The Masked Guardian
videos.overview: Ginnu with all his powers is unable to return Chatarpatar its voice. Meanwhile, Yasmine quickly realizes the masked guardian's weakness and defeats him so they can continue with their search for the Kala Chirag. Later, Rukhsar and Ginnu teleport to Angoothi Chaap's location and ask him about his fealty to Zeher.

videos.title: Kala Chirag Found
videos.overview: Anguthi Chaap is on his deathbed when he gives Chatarpatar its voice back. Chatarpatar claims that consuming water from a jheel can heal anyone's wounds. Ginnu and Chatarpatar immediately leave on a quest to find the Jheel. Meanwhile, Zafar releases the Kala Ginn, and Aladdin and Yasmine tell him to request the Kala Ginn to stop the shooting star from destroying the world.

videos.title: Kala Ginn Takes Over Aladdin's Body
videos.overview: Angoothi Chaap reveals Zafar had separated his body from his soul and secured his soul in a locket. Rukhsar immediately sets out to find this locket so they can fight against Zafar and Kala Ginn. Meanwhile, Ginn teleports to Aladdin and Yasmine who get sealed by Zafar in their fight and quickly releases them. However, the worst nightmare comes true when Kala Gin takes over Aladdin's body and continues to assist Zafar in his quest for world domination.

videos.title: Zafar Defeated
videos.overview: Rukhsar arrives with the locket containing Zafar's room and manages to turn the tide in their favour. Later, Aladdin delivers the finishing strike to Zafar, and everyone celebrates their victory. They come back to the castle and help Aladdin and Yasmine with their marriage ceremonies.

videos.title: Aladdin's Heroics
videos.overview: Aladdin saves all the workers who might have died by getting crushed under the falling statue. Everyone praises Aladdin for his heroics, on the other hand, Rukhsar is missing Aladdin and makes his favourite dish for the kids around her.

videos.title: The Blue Diamond
videos.overview: Zafar Khan is the Wazir-e-Azam of Baghdad, who wishes to get his hands on the magic lamp and marry Princess Yasmine to become the Emperor of Baghdad, but Princess Yasmine wants to become the first Empress of Baghdad herself. Aladdin receives his next mission to steal Zimmidar Habibullah's, Blue Diamond.

videos.title: And Thats How They Met
videos.overview: The Black Theif, Aladdin, is assigned to steal the famous Blue Diamond so the owner of the diamond, Zimmidar Habibullah comes to Princess Yasmine and asks her for protection. Princess Yasmine herself goes to the place where the diamond is kept and Aladdin reaches there to steal the diamond.

videos.title: The Search For The Magic Lamp
videos.overview: Aladdin is assigned to find the magic lamp by Wazir-e-Azam Zafar Khan, who gives him a map. The map leads Aladdin to Manghreb Dessert, where he struggles to find the lamp. On his way, he comes across Princess Yasmine in Salim Khilji's den.

videos.title: Baghdad In Danger Again?
videos.overview: Malika is about to step outside the portal but Jinoo uses his power and closes the portal at the last moment. Aladdin, Yasmine and Jinoo celebrate their victory over successful stopping Malika from entering. But they're mistaken as Malika's face appears in the sky.

videos.title: Will Yasmine Accept Aladdin’s Proposal?
videos.overview: Baghdad is celebrating Jashn-e-Dilbar, the festival of love. Mallika enters Baghdad and starts following Aladdin. Later, Aladdin proposes to Yasmine. Will she accept?

videos.title: Malika Takes a Disguise!
videos.overview: Malika pretends to be Yasmine’s aunt and writes to her, informing about her visit to Baghdad. She states that her kingdom was destroyed in an earthquake and that’s the reason for her visit. Yasmine requests Aladdin to receive her. Aladdin and Jingoo go to receive the aunt, who’s actually Malika in disguise.

videos.title: Malika and Aladdin Enter the Palace
videos.overview: Malika and Aladdin enter the palace. JM and Yasmine are having a conversation when a glass vase breaks and JM believes it to be a bad omen. Meanwhile, Jinoo and other genies realise that their magic has suddenly stopped working.

videos.title: Mallika Impersonates Yasmine’s Aunt
videos.overview: Upon reaching the palace, Yasmine enquires with Aladdin about her aunt. She reminds him that he had to fetch her. Aladdin clarifies that she never turned up. Yasmine criticises her aunt. But Mallika, pretending to be the aunt, overhears Yasmine and comes face-to-face with her.

videos.title: Malika’s Truth Revealed?
videos.overview: While on the palace tour with Aladdin and Yasmine, Malika senses that something is off. When she reaches the kitchen, she finds out that JM and CJ are performing magic in their genie form. Malika is totally shocked.

videos.title: Malika’s Sudden Announcement
videos.overview: Malika knows the advantages that Aladdin has because of his three genies and a magic carpet. She knows that she needs to be in his good books. During dinner, Malika announces the engagement of Aladdin and Yasmine. Everybody is surprised by this sudden announcement.

videos.title: Malika’s Hidden Motive
videos.overview: The engagement preparations are in full swing. Malika has a hidden motive behind getting Aladdin and Yasmine engaged. She reveals this hidden motive, which is to destroy the world using an instrument.

videos.title: Malika Faces A Hurdle
videos.overview: Malika requires a dagger in order to put her plan in action. Malika can use this dagger to make a genie tonic which can be used to turn people into genies. Malika currently has only one of the genie tonics remaining. So, she requires the dagger to make some more of it. But there is one person stopping her from actualizing her plan.

videos.title: The Dagger Thief
videos.overview: When Malika tells her story about the missing dagger, she reveals that the one who stole her dagger is from Baghdad as he had Baghdad’s badge on him.

videos.title: Malika Hunts For The Correct Key
videos.overview: Malika is in search of the correct key that will bring her closer to finding the dagger. She uses her powers to summon all the keys to her room, after which all the people of Baghdad cannot find their keys. Aladdin is confused as to how everybody cannot find their keys in Baghdad. Aladdin and CJ enter Malika’s room as Malika is looking for the correct key in her room. What will happen next?
